An 8 year old girl is missing at North Bondi. A young boy suffers a spinal injury on his birthday. And the Bondi Lifeguards 'Dads Club' welcomes its newest members ‚Äì as Whippet, Harries and Deano all bring their kids to Bondi.

Beachgoers report a drunk woman missing in the water, and the chopper is called in to search. On Australia Day, Whippet enlists honorary lifeguard Jon, a 16 year-old boy with Asperger's Syndrome. And the most critical rescue of the season stirs up emotional memories for Terry.

62-year-old lifeguard Harry faces the risk of losing his job as he competes against younger colleagues in a fitness test, thieves face a violent citizens arrest and lifeguards are startled by the frantic search of a mother calling for her daughter, Jennifer.

The national borders are open and international tourists flock to Bondi. Hoppo picks a random beachgoer to demonstrate his Float To Survive technique. Chase meets a local diver who invites him to check out Bondi's grey nurse shark colony.
The boys try conquer their fear of sharks, but diving with great whites may only make things worse. And tragedy strikes, as lifeguards must recover the body of a young man found dead in the surf.

Police are called when lifeguards focus their security camera on a man assaulting women in the surf. Lifeguards take part in a 30 day fitness and diet challenge, but some of them aren't playing by the rules. So Kerrbox plots to catch out childhood friend Hoppo with some contraband foods.

A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."

Christmas time and North Bondi becomes the North Pole as reindeers join Santa for a beach visit. Though it's not all happy holidays for a young local boy who suffers a serious accident in the skate bowl. And the festive spirit turns deadly with a nasty combination of alcohol and surf.

Cyclonic swell hits Bondi Beach with 12-foot waves, posing a significant challenge for Harries during a board rescue off Ben Buckler. In addition to the man in danger, H intervenes to lecture drunken youths burying beer bottles in the sand. New drone life vest technology is tested at Bondi Beach.

Lifeguards face frustrating distractions involving lost gear, wayward children, ball games, and somersaults. A mother searches for her 6-year-old son last seen in the surf. The arrival of blue bottles overwhelms the lifeguard tower, and a small boy must alert them to a drowning girl.

In the emotional finale episode, a mass rescue unfolds in Backpackers, Hoppo ties the knot, and trainees Glick and Jethro get a final chance to impress the boss. Veteran lifeguard Harry Nightingale receives a farewell fit for a legend after 18 years of service.

Trainee lifeguard and Bra Boy member Jesse fractures his spine when dumped by a huge wave. Jake rescues a beginner surfer being smashed against cliffs. Matt Dee hopes to do at least one board rescue before the season ends. Lifeguards farewell summer in huge surf by riding hand built surf craft.

Three new 18-year-old Bondi lifeguards‚ Dylan, Chase, and Noah now carry the weight of the Bondi community on their shoulders. Chase mans the tower alone, Dylan's maturity is revealed during a spinal incident, and master lifeguard Hoppo apprehends a thief off the beach.

A surfer seeks refuge at the tower from an angry beachgoer, requiring lifeguards to maintain public safety until police arrive. Colorful characters visit the beach, including Spiderman and Green Goblin. The annual lifeguard race has the participating teams getting highly competitive.

It's pack up time and Chappo sees a swimmer struggling to keep their head above water. Without a rescue board, Chappo sprints down the beach and dives into the water. Bagus doesn't want other lifeguards knowing he is participating in a nude photo shoot with two and half thousand other people.

The court case generates lots of publicity and Osgood is famous. A charismatic news reporter (Steve Forrest) takes to Osgood, but that doesn't sit well with Denham, who also has eyes for her.

Based on the novel by Edwin O'Connor, this political drama focuses on Frank Skeffington (Spencer Tracy), an aging mayor who is embarking on his final campaign for reelection. Aided by his nephew, Adam Caulfield (Jeffrey Hunter), and savvy strategist John Gorman (Pat O'Brien), Skeffington faces considerable challenges as the political landscape that he knows slowly crumbles away, but, undaunted, he remains determined to stay in the game a bit longer.

American Mark Thackeray (Sidney Poitier) recently received his degree in engineering, but cannot find work. To make ends meet, he takes a job as a teacher in a rough London East End school populated mostly with troublemakers who were rejected from other schools for their behavior. While the students at first see Thackeray as just another teacher open for ridicule and bullying, his calm demeanor and desire to see them succeed gradually earn him their respect.

Rejecting his cultured upper-class background as a classical pianist, Robert Dupea (Jack Nicholson) opts for a blue-collar existence, working in a California oil field and spending time with his waitress girlfriend, Rayette (Karen Black). But when Robert discovers that his father is gravely ill, he wants to reunite with his estranged family in the state of Washington. He and Rayette take a road trip that brings the two paths of his life to an uncomfortable intersection.

Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back.

The only business in the Wild West town of Jericho that corrupt sheriff Alex Flood (Dean Martin) doesn't control behind the scenes is the stagecoach owned by tough-willed widow Molly Lang (Jean Simmons) and her right-hand man, Hickman (John McIntire). Steven Rinella heads to the historic beaver trapping grounds of Wyoming to explore the legacy of the mountain man era. As he sets traps along the Green River, Steve immerses himself in the methods and stories of early American trappers. Alongside his quest to catch beavers, he delves into the fascinating history of how beavers shaped the fur trade and American frontier life. It's a journey through both the rugged landscapes and the rich heritage of the American West.

Steven Rinella joins ranch manager and wildlife biologist Ben Binnion in Texas to explore the often-overlooked aspects of hog management. Through encounters with both bears and the terrain, Steve seeks not just game but a connection to the past and the lessons it holds.

programmes.st: Close Encounter of the Sonic Kind
programmes.d: Sonic and Tails befriend a pair of aliens who crash land their spaceship on Mobius. Sonic has to avoid Robotnik's ULTRA-GRAVITIZER (sort of a hedgehog flypaper) to help fix their ship and blast-off back home.

Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

Outraged by a new hit song written about Sonic, Robotnik outlaws music on Mobius then takes pop star, Catty Carlisle captive. With his MD (Music Destroyer) Robot, Robotnik terrorizes the music loving Mobius population till Sonic rescues Catty.
A fast talking, travelling salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik various hedgehog-catching gadgets, including the Darkenator, the Super-duper Gravity Stopper, and the De-Atomizer.
Sonic rescues Lucas, a rival of Robotnik's, from Robotnik's dungeons. But Robotnik will do anything to keep Lucas from finding his lost love, Lucinda, including proposing to her himself.
Big Griz, leader of a group of biker-bear rebels, mistakes Scratch and Grounder for Sonic and Tails, and teams up with S and G to attack the real Sonic and Tails.
Tails gets a megadose of Robotniks growth gas and grows quickly to monstrous proportions, eating everything in sight and accidentally terrorizing the countryside.

When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home, Robotnik finds out, and creates a robot fox family which poses as Tails' long lost parents. Sonic leaves Tails with the fox family, but finally realizes they're robots and rescues Tails.

In Part II, Sonic and Sally steal the Roboti-sizer plans, stop the Destroyer from polluting the Great Forest and save Little Sonic, Little Sally and Dulcy's mother, Sabina.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programmes.d: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.
Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programmes.st: A Mayan League of their Own
programmes.d: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.
Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programmes.st: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programmes.d: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover.  Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.
Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again.  Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.
The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.
They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but, confused and traumatized, it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being, and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy "Funhouse" horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

Assistant Principle Bone shuts down the school newspaper because of Doug's unflattering cartoon of the school's least favorite lunch food, magic meat. Doug and Skeeter are having trouble finding a scary monster for their movie.

programmes.st: Doug's Hot Property/Doug & The Little Liar
programmes.d: Some tough highschoolers offer to sell Doug the rarest Man-O-Steel Man comic book, the only issue he is missing. Doug is convinvced that Skeeter's new girlfriend, Loretta, is a liar, and Skeeter is blindly being taken for a ride.

Oblina, long used to being the star pupil, finds herself challenged to the limit by a gifted transfer student from another dump.  Ickis steals a magicians hat, assuming that its powers will make him the most popular monster at the academy.

programmes.st: Legend of Kid Friendly / Silent But Deadly

programmes.d: Daggett and Norbert accompany Stump to his family reunion because Stump is a bit leery about meeting his wood-clad kinfolk. Norb warns Dag not to embarrass him as he usually does.

Eliza will stop at nothing to get a look at the gigantic, fierce Komodo Dragon that lives on Southeast Asian Islands.  Her plans are halted when the unexpected arrival of her home-schooling teacher forces her to hit the books.
When the girls discover that their parents have mistakenly taken embarrassing home movies to an awards banquet, they join forces in order to save face.
When Eliza sneaks out ahead of her parents in order to find a rare Sumatran Rhino, she discovers that expose of his life would only lead to its extinction.

Eliza finds an animal hero in a giraffe who can see great distances with his height and warn others of approaching danger.  However,  to Eliza's dismay, the giraffe skips out on the animals for his own needs. O

Eliza frees a Hyena, but since it never lived in the wild it doesn't know how to survive.  Eliza attempts to teach it, but it seems hopeless until a wild boar threatens them and the hyena's natural instincts take over.

Darwin brings Eliza to a chimpanzee compound.  When Eliza is not being subservient to the hierarchy, Darwin gets in hot water with the leader. Only after a threatening fire starts does Eliza realize the necessary hierarchy for jungle survival.

Eliza pulls the wrong lever and catapults the commvee to the bottom of the deeper waters of Australia!  She is soon forced to don scuba gear and enlist the help of an army of dugongs in order to rescue her dad!
Debbie discovers Eliza talking to dingoes and threatens to tell her parents. Eliza is afraid of being shipped back to the United States as a science experiment, seeks help from nearby Aborigines.

The Thornberrys meet the Fensterkopfs, who make false documentaries. The Fensterkopf's kid lies to Eliza and gets them stuck on a cliff.  After the families barely escape an avalanche, the value of truth is learned by all.
Logan wants to join the secret society on campus; Quinn insists that she has not met the latest transfer student.

Rachel moves to another town and fearing the worst, Tommy braces for a long mourning period. This is cut short when he meets Anita. When Rachel turns up unexpectedly, Tommy finds himself between a rock and a hard place.
Kimi heads a petition to ban cell phones in school, but Angelica drives a wedge between the siblings by hoodwinking Chuckie into helping her petition against the ban.
When the gang's parents feel that they are spending too much time watching TV, they ban it from the house. How will the gang get by without their favorite programs?

Tommy and Dil host a viewing party for a real alien autopsy video. But when both Grandpa Lou and Grandpa Boris show up to babysit the kids, can the gang find a way to watch the inappropriate tape before Dil has to give it back?
Susie is discovered as a great singing talent by an agent who leads her to believe she's going to be the next teen superstar.
Lil strikes a blow for independence from a bewildered Phil. Chuckie takes a defiant stand against the mandatory President's Fitness Test.

Chuckie adopts an alter ego in order to gain the attention of a popular girl who doesn't even know he exists. Angelica, needing a juicy expose to insure her 'ace' reporter status, takes on Pepe, the eccentric cafeteria chef and his unconventional cuisine.

Kimi befriends Z, the proverbial bad boy. Chuckie's alarms go off and he is determined to prove to his sister this kid is up to no good. Meanwhile, Angelica is unable to do her online Ask Angelica advice chat and uses Harold to sit in.

Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

The guys are caught in a web of lies. Kendall has to keep Jo from discovering Lucy has returned to the Palm Woods. Logan’s fib about being sick turns into a medical emergency and Carlos and James claim Rocque Records was robbed.
Big Time Bonus: Gustavo gives the guys a bonus for their hard work, but they quickly begin to make bad decisions with their money.
Mrs. Hayfer needs a house sitter and it's the boys to the rescue, but all doesn't go according to plan when they meet Tiberius, a vicious dog with an appetite for..Drake & Josh?!
It's Aunt Catherine's wedding day, and Drake and Josh are in charge of picking up the cake.   But their wedding plans get crashed when their car breaks down.
After Mindy tells Josh she loves him, Josh turns to the only logical place for advice: Drake.
Now that Josh is no longer dating Mindy he wants to play the field and challenges Drake to a bet to see who can score more dates.
Drake and Josh meet the "Great" Henry Doheny, one of the greatest magicians ever - who has fallen on tough times.
Get your chopsticks ready.   The good times roll when the boys work in a sushi factory to earn the money to buy the living room furniture back after an anniversary present for their parents go awry.
When True gets two tickets to a fancy ball, Lulu and Ryan compete to be her date, but True has another date in mind.
Max discovers a top-secret environmentally friendly material on a trip to Africa, while a college student follows True around for a day.
Amanda hires one of the mean girls at True's school.

True Jackson has a passion for fashion. She gets the chance of a lifetime when she's hired as the VP for a major fashion label.  The problem? Her new coworkers are not too thrilled to have a 15 year old as their boss.
Max enlists the help of True, Ryan, and Lulu to propose to his girlfriend, Doris, who is expecting something original.

Ditch Day Afternoon: Kenan and Kel decide to skip a day of school and work.  They call in sick, but soon find themselves in big trouble when they get caught in a bank robbery and end up on the national news.

programmes.st: Get the Kel Out of Here
programmes.d: Get the Kel Out of Here: After a series of mishaps, Kenan's dad forbids Kel from ever entering the Rockmore house.
Foul Bull: When Ron Harper slips on some orange soda while visiting Rigby's, the Chicago Bulls' season is in jeopardy and the entire city of Chicago blames Kenan and Kel.

The Crush: There's a substitute teacher in class and Kel is sure she has a crush on Kenan.  Kenan doesn't believe it at first, but Kel is persistent and persuasive.  He begins to convince Kenan that he may be right.

BTR is making a cameo on a popular kid’s TV show, but Carlos’ pursuit of the show’s teen star puts him and Kendall in the crosshairs of her evil stage mother. Logan & James battle Yo Gabba Gabba over their amazing snack table.
It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.
Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.
The whole gang has gathered at Drake and Josh's house before Drake's big concert, but thanks to Walter's poor weather predictions they end up stuck in the house due to severe rain.

Beka and Tyr are taken over by the energy from a dimensional tunnel. Dylan, Trance, and Harper must save them before they destroy the ship.
Dylan is framed for murder and must clear his name, all while finding the pieces of a vase said to grant the owner the "blessings of the cosmos."
The crew rescues a group of refugees, only to discover they have been subject to government experiments and are extremely unstable.
Beka's Uncle Sid runs for office in the New Commonwealth, but an assassination attempt causes the crew to act as his security.

The crew discovers that a rogue planet, Marduk, has been creating weapons of mass destruction.
A hitman by the name of the Leper is targeting the leaders of the New Commonwealth.
The Andromeda is haunted by a mysterious creature that comes aboard during a solar storm.

programmes.st: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programmes.d: When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.

programmes.st: The Final Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: By revealing to each other a fearless embrace of the unknown, Giorno and Mista emerge victorious against Ghiaccio. Now, a single member of Bruno’s group must face a single bell tower, a single elevator shaft, and a single menacing task.

In the crypt of a Venetian church, Bruno discovers not only the brutal truth behind the Boss’s true intentions but also the unstoppable Stand power he wields, a power that leaves Bruno in a pool of blood and in a moral quandary.
Peer into the complex personal pasts of Bucciarati and his fellow gang members, and uncover the thread that unites this diverse group of fighters into a single team and single expression of resolve.

After Hattie finds out that Danny got a promotion, she asks him to help pay for Linda's wedding.
Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.
Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing, and the children train for their participation in the charity walk.

programmes.st: The Hand on a House Episode
programmes.d: Nick and others enter a contest to win a house.
A new morning show is launched at the station, but Nick must cohost it with a self-serving reality star. Meanwhile, Marilyn moves in with the family.
A newlywed couple (Terry Crews, Essence Atkins) with two children face various blended-family obstacles in this sitcom based on the 2005 film of the same name. First up
Cash-flow problems strike the family when Suzanne's credit issues surface and Nick's work necessitates a new van.

Ryan faces off with a close friend who feels he committed the ultimate betrayal. Kitty begins her tenure at 2nd City Ink. Even with a baby on the way, Phor tries to put the brakes on his relationship with Nina, only to have to deal with her mother.

As Nina, stuck at the apartment and eight months pregnant, waits for Phor to get home, she finally decides to pack up her things and move out. Phor asks the 9MAG guys for advice and seeks solace in his music, spending more late nights at the studio.
The shop is divided over Ceaser's choice to replace Sky, Young Bae and Rob receive devastating news, and Teddy flips when Tati gets wasted and goes home with another guy.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew My Big Fat Black Ink Wedding
programmes.d: The crew parties in bougie Westchester, NY, before Bae's wedding, "father-of-the-bride" Ceaser is pissed to learn O'S**t is invited, and Tati tries to mend things with Teddy.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew The Black Ink Survivor's Club
programmes.d: Sky's vengeful return and an emergency involving Rob throw Bae's wedding into chaos, Teddy and Tati make it official, and the fired employees of Black Ink come together.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew While On Duty, You Can Get Booty
programmes.d: Sky has a run-in with an enemy, Alex faces a medical emergency, Ceaser gets protective when his daughter goes on her first date, and a violent act leads to chaos at the shop.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew I Love Shopping! I Love America!
programmes.d: An act of violence against the shop leaves the crew concerned, Black Ink gets a new receptionist, Teddy questions Tatiana's loyalty, and Alex receives heartbreaking news.
The crew helps Walt raise funds at a casino, Alex explores his legal options, Sky travels to Miami to look after her shop, and Ted and Tatiana's relationship hits a roadblock.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Always Bet on Black Ink
programmes.d: Donna teams up with Ceaser's enemy to take him down, the crew bets big to help Walt, and Sky's son Des meets his biological father, despite his mom's initial disapproval.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Peace Out, America!
programmes.d: The crew throws a going-away party for Mama Bae, Alex moves into Donna's place, Ceaser receives devastating news, and Sky hosts the grand opening of her shop in Miami.
Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2
programmes.d: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.
Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.
Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

When a homicide case ends in a hung jury, Erin is forced to take over the case from her colleague, ADA Kelly Blake (Diane Neal), and with the help of DA investigator Anthony Abetemarco (Steve Schirripa), find a missing witness.
Danny is interrogated by the District Attorney’s investigator when his ex-partner is accused of planting evidence in order to wrap up a homicide case.
When a local mobster is gunned down in his car, Danny and Baez try to get information from the mob’s low-level errand boy they find tied up in the trunk before the gang retaliates.
When Frank’s first partner announces plans to publish a book filled with stories of their early days on the force, Frank worries about his personal stories being made public.
When a well-regarded, newly retired NYPD lieutenant is accused of shooting a group of potential muggers on the subway and then disappears, Frank must deal with the fallout.
Danny must determine who murdered a man when multiple women who worked for him all take credit for it.
Erin is overwhelmed with guilt after a man she set free is accused of killing a cop.
Linda asks Danny and Baez to help her co-worker who is having trouble with her angry ex-husband.

Jamie and Danny disagree about how to handle a reckless NYPD rookie, Marcus (Michael Drayer), who is the son of Danny’s friend. Also, when Erin’s investigator, Anthony, gets roped into a bad investment by his cousin, she offers to look into it.
Frank and Danny work together to help Nick Constantine (Michael Nouri), a rehabilitated ex-con who Frank put away years ago when Constantine becomes involved in the murder of an old enemy.
While hunting for a robbery crew on a wild crime spree, Danny and Baez partner with Detective Jimmy Mosley (Johnathon Schaech), a detective from another precinct who broke Baez’s heart years ago.
When serial killer Thomas Wilder (Louis Cancelmi) attaches a message to his latest victim that taunts Danny, their deadly game of cat and mouse becomes personal for Danny.
When a key eyewitness in a murder trial flees out of fear of retaliation, Erin and Anthony spearhead their own two-person manhunt to find him and convince him to testify.
Frank, the Mayor, Erin, and the DA’s office contend with public outrage after a grand jury doesn’t indict an NYPD officer for the controversial shooting of a teenager that was caught on video.
Danny's world is rocked when Robert Lewis (Michael Imperioli) in the Attorney General's office obtains new evidence against him in the self-defense shooting case of serial killer Thomas Wilder.
Danny and Baez are determined to get justice for a traumatized young woman who was held hostage, despite her resistance to press charges.

Intent on bringing justice to Lieutenant Gormley after he is beaten by a mob outside his home, Danny and Frank enlist the aid of Detective Anthony Abetemarco, who has a personal connection to the neighborhood where the attack occurred.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.
With a storm brewing, Adam takes refuge at a way station, run by cantankerous Jesse and his young grandaughter Marty, who yearns to see what exists away from the way station.
Juan Ortega claims he has a land grant which gives him ownership of the entire Nevada Territory.
Mary Wharton, an old friend of the family, comes to live on the Ponderosa with her shiftless husband.  When Ben learns Mary is the victim of domestic abuse, he sends Russ packing.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.

Virginia City's newest preacher is an ex-gunfighter who wants only to build a new church, but the brother of one of his victims has other ideas.  The blueprints for the church are said to be a gift from Adam.
Ben must determine who is the rightful heir to a fortune that includes water rights vital to the Ponderosa.
Ben is attracted to Sarah Reynolds, a member of a religious order led by her fanatical uncle.  When she is accused of being a witch, the Cartwrights step in.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.
After his only friend is killed, the Cartwrights take in a slow-witted man, who Roy Coffee informs them, is wanted for murder by Arizona authorities.

For a change, it is Adam rather than Joe who becomes mixed up in one of Hoss' funny exploits. Together they purchase a thoroughbred horse, and end up competing against their little brother in the big Virginia City race.

The Cartwrights are visited by their second cousin, Muley Jones of Weedville, Missouri who sings with a window-shattering voice and stirs up trouble with Indian negotiations that Ben is trying to ensure.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.
Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.
Outlaws capture Ben and hide him in an abandoned mine, holding him for a ransom.  The boys must come up with a plan to save him before it's too late.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.st: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
programmes.d: Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected
Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack.
The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen.
Inojin has loved to draw since he was small, and his ninjutsu speciality is the Super Beast Scroll. But one day, he suddenly loses his ability to use his jutsu!

programmes.st: The Night of the Shooting Stars
programmes.d: Boruto and his classmates decide to go camping to try to catch the mysterious fish, the Eternal Carp, said to be unforgettably delicious.
As the students prepare for their finals, Boruto meets a journalist named Sukea who is doing a story on them.

Boruto and the others complete the first-round written exam and move on to the next. The second round has the students facing off against Kakashi and the academy instructors in actual combat situations.
Boruto's the first to confront Kakashi in the exam. Despite a determined effort, he is immobilized and angered by Kakashi's severe criticism of his class.
Boruto and his classmates take their first step as genin and start forming their basic shinobi three-man squads.

programmes.st: The Path Lit by the Full Moon
programmes.d: Mitsuki faces a difficult decision, but his thoughts and feelings that had once been shrouded in mystery, now come to light.
Team 7 sets out on their first mission.
Team 7's original mission evolves into a rescue operation after Kiri is kidnapped.
Team 7 is assigned to capture a suspect who has barricaded himself inside a bank.
An incident occurs in Hidden Leaf Village and the Byakuya Gang is suspected.
The Byakuya Gang's activities become more brazen in the Hidden Leaf.

programmes.st: Memories from the Day of Snow
programmes.d: Ryogi is worried about Shikadai, but is tormented by memories he can't forget.

programmes.st: Go! The Crest of Night Strategy
programmes.d: The protest instigated by the Byakuya Gang against the Kaminarimon Company increases in intensity.

programmes.st: The Figure I Want to Be
programmes.d: Shikadai figures out what the Byakuya Gang's goal is and rushes after them in pursuit with Boruto close by.

Working with a Tokyo police officer, Five-O's Steve McGarrett tries to locate the source of a gun smuggling ring which is sending handguns to Japan.
Steve McGarrett searches for both a maniacal rapist-murderer and the district attorney's daughter who is lost in the mountains of Oahu, fearful in the meantime that they will encounter one another.
Hit-and-run kills police officer, driver turns out to be head of Honolulu gambling syndicate. Only witness, debt-ridden gambler, extorts driver with knowledge of crime.
Barnard Hughes guest stars as a 71-year-old walking bomb who is threatening to blow himself up along with a group of hostages if his demands to stop the demolition of his home are not met.

While vacationing in Hawaii, a popular female country singer is kidnapped for $500,000 ransom, and as McGarrett's Five-O force begins investigating, it appears that the victim and her abductors have perished at sea.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: An old flame of Gillespie’s reappears in Sparta to ask him for some professional help in assuring that her land is willed directly to her daughter, the product of the affair that she and Gillespie had twenty years ago. Stella Stevens guest stars.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Bubba gets involved when his cousin Candace and her husband Kevin are being blackmailed by Waylon Davis, the birth father of their adopted baby. Davis threatens to contest the adoption unless they cooperate, but will they give in to his demands?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Jeanette Marshall is a teacher in Sparta who has eye for the gentlemen, but her multiple romances attract negative attention from the townsfolk, and eccentric Ashe Crowe makes it his mission to put a permanent stop to Jeanette's flirtatious ways.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: The fun and games come to a halt when Edgar Van Buren, the wealthy host of an annual high-stakes poker party, is murdered. Gillespie and Tibbs must sift through the evidence of a case where everyone is a suspect, including the dead man’s wife.
Dr. Travis catches Dr. Sloan in his office, settling in with a bowl of popcorn to watch a reality television show, "Hot House," a "Big Brother" and "Real World" type series.

programmes.st: All Dressed Up And Nowhere To Die
programmes.d: Mark's friends Stanley and Tammy have decided to preview Tammy's new fashion line at their wedding.
At a spiritual retreat, Beth Scarburough confronts Father Dominick about his failed friendship with her husband, Matt. She pleads for him to make amends with his former friend.
To celebrate Walker's birthday, CD gives a book on the early life of Hayes Cooper. CD relates the adventure of the legendary Ranger protecting a wagon train from outlaws.

Country singer Lila McCann stars as Kelly Wyman, an aspiring country singer. One of the many obstacles this precocious teenager faces is a slick-talking talent agent, who is the mastermind behind a drug cartel that Walker is trying to bring down.

A young truck driver refuses to transport illegal drugs for a corrupt sheriff. The sheriff places a bomb on the driver's truck; the young man survives and goes into hiding. The boy's mother asks the Rangers to look into the matter.

Carlos' nephew Jesse is accused of killing a cop during a drug raid since the murder weapon is found in Jesse's possession. The gun was left in Jesse's care by one of his friends, and Jesse is forced to take the blame to protect his mother.
Kimble is mistakenly identified as the murderer of a neighborhood girl while working as an apartment building janitor in a slum.
Richard Kimble jeopardizes his own freedom to treat a critically ill infant.
Kimble saves the life of Maggie Tippet, the one-armed man's girlfriend.
After visiting an old flame who's now working as a Park Ranger, MacGyver finds himself in the middle of a grizzly poaching investigation.
MacGyver protects a 14-year-old from the mob after his grandfather is killed for refusing to sell out his international shipping company.
MacGyver and old friend Penny Parker uncover a skeleton on the grounds of a mansion inherited by Penny, and MacGyver works to solve a year-old mystery regarding the disappearance of Penny's aunt.
Cocky medical student, Hunter Koskov, coerces his classmates, Max and Jenny, to experiment with each other by inducing "death."
Amanda does a guest spot as a nurse on the soap opera, where she serves as a medical consultant. Star actress Thalia faints during a scene and is rushed to the emergency room.

Julia Adams comes to Dr. Sloan for a check-up. She seems a little anxious. At the same time, a man comes running through the hospital and in one highly restricted lab, knocks over and breaks a test tube.
Dr. Sloan questions old friend and newspaper baron Barclay about the security company.
With Henry away in New York on business and Alice having to spend the night with Henry's mother, Dennis stays with the Wilsons for a night.
Dennis takes Mr. Wilson's lawn edger without asking, so when Mr. Wilson sees Mrs. Elkins using an edger she recently purchased, he takes it believing it was stolen from him.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Revenge Is Sweet
programmes.d: Betty teases Bud about his sloppy nature after he meets her rich, refined boyfriend.
The Andersons' country cousin Milly comes to stay.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Poor Old Dad
programmes.d: Bud thinks his father is henpecked, so Jim shows him the true value of marriage.
Betty helps save an elderly restaurant owner from eviction by Jim's company.

A friend of Bill's confides that he is worried about his son growing up in a home with mostly females. That makes Bill wonder about Jody not having enough time with boys. Bill sends him off to camp. Jody pretends to like it.
Jody and Buff's school teacher is out for a few days, and there is a substitute teacher. Jody develops a crush on her.

Uncle Bill allows Buffy & Jody to have a friend stay over for a few days while the parents are out of town. But then Uncle Bill finds out the friend is actually a dog, and pets are not allowed in the apartment building.

Buffy makes friends with another girl in the apartment building and finds out the girl is very sick and may not live too much longer. Buffy asks Uncle Bill if they can have a Christmas holiday because Eve might not be alive in December.
A couple Mike and Carol know adopt a young boy, but the boy soon misses his two best friends--one African-American, one Asian-American. As a result, the couple decides to adopt all three boys.

Marcia battles nerves and Greg's sexist remarks when she tries to get her driver's license. Eventually, the debate over which gender has the better driving abilities leads to a winner-take-all driving test in a vacant parking lot.

Peter and Bobby believe they are seeing a UFO, which actually is part of an elaborate hoax being played by Greg. The trick backfires though when Peter and Bobby take pictures, which lead to a government investigation.
Cousin Oliver comes to live with the Bradys. He immediately causes a series of accidents, which lead him to believe that he is a jinx.
After Mike gets a visit from an FBI agent and Sam comes to him with some secret plans, Bobby and Oliver believe that Sam is a spy.

The Bradys get a new pool table (as a thank you gift from Mr. Matthews for Mike's recent performance). Bobby soon becomes an expert in billiards and - during a family party - beats Mike's boss in a game of pool.
Mike is set to go down to the blood bank to donate some blood and asks Archie if he would like to donate.

Gloria comes home from the doctor with some news: she's pregnant. This leads to a big argument between Archie and Mike so Mike decides to quit school and move out. Archie doesn't believe him until Mike gets a job in Detroit and plans on moving there.

programmes.st: Mike's Hippie Friends Come To Visit
programmes.d: Just before leaving on a flight to Europe, Mike's hippie friends need a place to stay for the night. Mike invites them to stay in the Bunker's living room, however, Archie objects citing that no unmarried couple will spend the night under his roof.

Archie discovers that a new family is moving to the neighborhood. He goes over to investigate, only to discover that the new family is black. Archie quickly hopes to round the neighborhood up and try to force the family out of the area.

Edith is all excited that she has been chosen for jury duty. When Archie realizes that she may be sequestered, he forbids her to be on the jury, wanting to keep her at home to cook and clean for him. When she is sequestered, Archie fends for himself.

programmes.st: Archie Is Worried About His Job
programmes.d: Archie stays up all night, expecting a phone call from a security guard who has information. It seems his company is laying off and he fears he may lose his job. No one else in the Bunker household can sleep either and it turns into a three ring circus.

Gloria has been reading books on women's lib and encourages Edith to try a little liberation. However, Mike won't take any of her ideas, which leads to huge fight in which Gloria demands that Mike recognize her as an equal partner in their marriage.

Archie is all set to go to the Mets game; however, Edith has different plans after she accepted an invitation to dinner with the Jeffersons. Archie discovers this and comes up with the excuse that Edith sprained her ankle, thus turns down the invitation.
Ellen talks Mama into holding Mayor Tutwiller's reelection campaign at her house, but when Mama ridicules the Mayor, he challenges her to run herself, much to Ellen's chagrin.
Mama is sworn in as Mayor and the whole family attends her inauguration, but she soon finds out that the job is not as easy as she originally thought.
Mama's vacuum cleaner has broken, and Vint tells her that she can use Naomi's. Mama uses it, but it blows up and ruins her rug. Mama and Naomi blame one another for this and take each other to court.

It is Mama's birthday, and all she wants is for everyone to help her clean the attic. Buzz is the only family member to not make up an excuse, so he ends up helping her as she reminisces about her thirtieth birthday.
Mama's brother-in-law Roy Harper has come to visit Carl for his birthday, not knowing that his brother is dead. Against Mama's wishes, Vint asks Roy to stay for a while.
While filling in for an advice columnist, Fran uses Mama's advice and becomes a hit. Since Mama has given Fran all her advice, Buzz insists Mama gets half of the profits, but Fran refuses.

Mama can't get anyone to go to the cemetery with her, so she just goes by herself. After arriving and having a long talk with Carl, she notices that the grave that is reserved for her actually has another woman there.

Mama's sister, Frannie, has just passed away, and she is determined to give her late sister something she never had a "perfect day." But things soon turn from perfect to terrible as one disaster after another strikes.

Mama discovers Fran is worth $35,000 and stipulates that a portion would be split evenly between Mama, Vint, and Naomi. One stipulation stands between Mama and the money, she has to keep from losing her temper for 2 weeks.

programmes.t: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programmes.d: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programmes.t: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programmes.d: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programmes.d: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto)...

programmes.t: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programmes.t: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programmes.d: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.
Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.
The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.
Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo. A closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered. Detectives ask, could she be the victim of a brutal serial killer? Or was Lisa murdered by someone she knew?

A forensic dentist helps police nab a child killer by showing that the teeth marks on the killer's arms match the teeth of the murdered boy. And telltale blood stains on a blue bandana solve the 10-year-old case of a teenage girl murdered.

DNA found on a marijuana joint in Florida in 2005 helps to solve the 1988 rape and murder of a California woman. And a cold case of murder in Illinois heats up when a jailhouse lawyer turns jailhouse snitch.

Police run down more than 11,000 leads before coming up with a suspect in the murders of three Virginia girls, and the abduction and strangulation of a California woman continue to baffle the investigators more than 11 years after the crime.
Forty-one years after the crime, a woman implicates her brother and cousin in the murder of a policeman.

Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field. The investigation yields hundreds of leads but no true suspect. After more than two decades on ice, the case is revived.

Cops finally close in on a serial killer with the help of the Internet. And a drug trafficker jumps bail goes into the bike shop business and helps pioneer the sport of mountain biking while he's on the lam.

When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August of 1986, residents of Tacoma panic. This is the second young girl killed in five months. Convinced a predator is loose, Police embark on a 32-year inquiry.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programmes.st: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.
When the batteries in Sarah's TV remote die, she embarks on an odyssey to find new ones; Brian and Steve discuss politics.
Sarah gets picked up on a DUI, and Brian insists that he's a bisexual.
The guys try to get rid of a motivational speaker when she begins interfering with a beloved office awards show.
The guys become party gods after an energy drink company starts paying them to throw ragers.
When the guys have to pass a drug test at work, they only have one choice: bribe middle school kids for clean urine.
Rumors of a possible promotion spread at work and test the guys' allegiances as they all vie for the new job.
The guys will stop at nothing to get tickets to a sold-out basketball game, even if it means being dunked in a horchata tank and seeing a grown man's penis.
While their house is being fumigated, the guys decide to crash at the office and do a bunch of drugs, but their campout is threatened when two burglars break into the office.
Mr. Garvey clashes with students over club photos, and President Obama addresses the NSA scandal.
Two women prepare to fight outside a club, and the Valets wonder why people mess with the Batmans.
Two slaves try to find a way out of fighting to the death, and a member of a Latin gang proves his toughness.
A passenger finds out that he's far from the first to board, and some breakdancers keep it nooice.

Nathan goes to great lengths to create the perfect talk show anecdote.
Sam accidentally becomes a prostitute, and Tim comes down with a bad case of colitis.
Tim and Sam try to convince a Motown legend to sing a jingle for a local wig company.
The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.
Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.
A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.
While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.
Stan and kyle are psyched to have Wendy and Bebe visit their clubhouse for a game of Truth or Dare, but first, they have to build one.
South Park's 14th Annual "Cow Days" rodeo and carnival is here and the boys are determined to win Terrance and Phillip dolls.
After a huge loss in court, Chef is left penniless, but he has some very famous and talented friends in the music business who want to help their old mentor.
When Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes a monthly visit, she brings a mysterious pet fish for Stan.
Dinner with Cartman's family takes a bizarre twist when Uncle Howard shows up after breaking out of prison with the help of his cellmate, Charlie Manson.
Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny are assigned to write a report with Tweek, the very nervous and highly caffeinated boy who insists gnomes are stealing his underpants.
The boys' discovery of a man encased in ice threatens Stan and Kyle's friendship.

The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire. Also, Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall (Gail O'Grady) don't go as planned.
