programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Training Camp opens and many of the new candidates have had to uproot their lives and move to Dallas with no guarantee of making it through Training Camp to become a Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: It is just the second week of rehearsals and Kelli and Judy are quick to run the Training Camp Candidates through the signature kick line and jump split.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: In week three of training camp, the rookie candidates are brought in for their DCC makeover.  Under the scrutiny of Kelli Finglass, new hairstyles and makeup applications give the girls the DCC look.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: It's week five of training camp and Kelli is out sick.  DCC Technical Director, Kitty Carter, fills in and runs the first rehearsal of the week.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Week 7 of training camp begins with a rehearsal on the field at Cowboys Stadium.  Kelli and Judy are ready to make final cuts and tonight's rehearsal could determine who makes the squad.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: It's time to announce the DCC squad but first Kelli and Judy put the candidates through a final field rehearsal at Cowboys Stadium.  Tensions run high among the girls as Kelli and Judy watch their every step.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The squad has their first game day performance behind them, but after a bad rehearsal, Kelli warns her new team she will cut girls if they don't give 110 percent.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take a break from the sidelines and travel to Mexico for their annual swimsuit calendar photo shoot.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are in full dance mode preparing for their first regular-season home game performance. Kelli and Judy want the choreography to be perfect and press the girls through a few intense rehearsals.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: In the final episode of the series, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are preparing for their marquee performance - The Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show during a nationally televised Cowboys football game.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Dreams are on the line as the tryouts for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 squad begin.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The pressure is mounting as 54 new candidates compete with 32 returning veterans for an invitation into the famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders training camp.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Training camp begins at the Cowboys famous training facility, Valley Ranch. First Meeting is filled with excitement and energy until Kelli calls a special meeting of the veterans.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The "scariest night of training camp" kicks off this dramatic episode as the girls learn the dreaded jumpsplit! It's mind over body, as the girls attempt this famed and required move.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The ladies are really challenged when guest choreographer DJ Guthrie teaches them a new dance style.  Kelli and Judy have some tough decisions to make about who will remain on the squad.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The training camp candidates hold their breath as the one and only Kitty Carter pays a visit to training camp.  Kitty takes no prisoners as she rips into the new girls as well as the vets.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With their futures on the line, the training camp candidates try to push through their heightened emotions to show Kelli and Judy they deserve to be part of America's Sweethearts.  Unfortunately, for some "Tonight will be your last night".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: This is it, the last chance, as the girls finally learn their fate. Dreams start coming true as the girls pose for Squad Photo.  There is some great dancing as Show Group and the rest of the squad perform for the first time at a new "Meet The Team" event.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Begin the journey to see who will survive the most demanding dance audition in professional sports. 500 ladies put their dreams on the line as they try to become a famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, for the 2014-2015 season.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With 55 high caliber girls making it to finals, it's intimidating for the 30 veterans as they join the audition process & must fight to keep their place. Kitty Carter takes no prisoners as she prepares girls for their solos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As training camp begins with 43 ladies, the pressure starts to build!  Kelli's passion is infectious and intimidating in First Meeting, as she sets the expectations very high.  Seven girls will be cut to make a squad of 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Fear takes over for the new Training Camp Candidates as they face the reality of doing the DCC kick line & jump splits for the first time. Dreams come true if only temporarily, as the girls try on the uniform for the first time.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: What Happens in Flavor Stays in Flavor
programmes.st: What Happens in Flavor Stays in Flavor
programmes.d: Flavor Flav is a good luck person. So he needs a good luck woman. To test the girls on this trait, he flies the seven remaining women to Vegas on his private jet.
There's six girls left so Flav brings out the big guns. He flies Brigitte Neilsen into town to get to know the girls a little better.
Flav takes two of the young ladies to Palm Springs for a spa retreat where things get muddy, wet and crazy.
Three girls are left! Things are getting serious so Flav decides it's time to meet the ladies' parents.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: The Slaps, Smacks, Screams and Spit You Never Saw
programmes.st: The Slaps, Smacks, Screams and Spit You Never Saw
programmes.d: A lot of crazy stuff has happened in Flav's house since the girls arrived.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Viva La Flav
programmes.d: The final two girls remain. To celebrate having made it this far, Flav takes the two girls to Puerto Vallarta for an exotic three day Mexican getaway.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: After the Lovin (Finale)
programmes.d: Flavor Flav and all 20 of the original Flavorettes are back for a reunion show like you've never seen before.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Sumthin's Stinkin' in the House of Flav
programmes.st: Sumthin's Stinkin' in the House of Flav
programmes.d: Flavor Flav welcomes 20 new women to his mansion with the hope of finding someone real this time around.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Flav is Blind
programmes.d: Flavor Flav challenges his remaining fourteen Flavorettes to a blind speed dating competition (to get to know them without the influence of physicality-ness).

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: She Works Hard for Her Honey
programmes.st: She Works Hard for Her Honey
programmes.d: Twelve girls are left and jealousy is running rampant. Flav divides the girls into groups of six and presents them with two challenges.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Jelly on the Telly
programmes.d: Flavor Flav wants a girl who knows how to move.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Famous Friends and Strangeness
programmes.d: Flavor Flav knows everyone who's anyone in the hip hop industry and today he wants to have them all over to his house.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Who Loves New York? (Photo Shoot To The Death)
programmes.st: Who Loves New York? (Photo Shoot To The Death)
programmes.d: Just like last season, Flav has invited a special guest from his past to help give him input on his selection of ladies.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Boxin' Each Other Out
programmes.d: The five girls left want the inside scoop, so he puts all five of the girls in the parlor with a ballot box and pictures of themselves.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Steppin' Out Flav Style
programmes.d: Four girls are left and it's time to go on a little trip. Flav takes two girls down to the shore for a day of sailing with his ladies as crew. Then to the luxurious Queen Mary for an overnight.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Oh No She Didn't! (Clip Show)
programmes.d: A lot of incredible stuff has happened in Flav's house since the girls' arrived.
Scales, tails and eyes oh my! Who's afraid of whole fish? Not Alton Brown.
Before your good fruit goes bad, take a tip from Alton Brown and dry it.
Alton Brown demonstrates why great stew is like great music.
Alton helps a humble cucumber fulfill its destiny of becoming a pickle.
Alton turns a handful of peanuts into some seriously good eats.
Alton Brown reinvents the classic green bean casserole.
Learn how to turn the blueberry into a year-round treat.
Alton shares the sweet, sticky science behind homemade marshmallows.
Join Alton Brown as he explores what it takes to stay sharp in the kitchen.
The Wing's the thing as Alton prepares the most ubiquitous of bar foods.
Alton Brown makes everybody's favorite -- the classic apple pie.

programmes.st: If It Ain't Broccoli Don't Fix It
programmes.d: Alton transforms broccoli from limp and bitter to crisp and delicious.
Alton proves crown roast of lamb doesn't have to be intimidating.
Join Alton as he breaks the trend toward an overly sweet and fussy pastry.
Alton breaks out the cast iron to whip up some good eats.
Alton Brown explores the many uses of a super fruit -- the cranberry.
Alton creates popover dishes, from a breakfast treat to a dinner classic.
Celery: it's not just a conveyance for peanut butter anymore.
Alton Brown is challenged to raise the bar on canned tuna.
Alton Brown untangles the wide variety of edible oils.
Alton Brown elevates the humble home freezer into a food-saving powerhouse.
Alton explores the origins and preparation of shepherd's pie and mincemeat.
That culinary chameleon, the soybean, turns up as edamame.

programmes.st: Flat is Beautiful IV: Going Crackers
programmes.d: Alton proves that the humble cracker is vastly improved when homemade.

programmes.st: American Classics III: Creole in a Bowl
programmes.d: Alton explores the cultural influences behind a New Orleans classic.
Alton tames finicky phyllo dough to create baklava.
Alton explores that zesty rhizome -- ginger.
Alton reluctantly agrees to help refurbish Brussels sprouts' reputation.
Alton creates a drink, a topping and a creamy cold dessert from oranges.

programmes.st: Pantry Raid X: The Dark Side of the Cane
programmes.d: Alton resurrects this historic and versatile syrup, molasses.
Alton Brown proves wild salmon is worth every penny.
Alton explores a bayou staple and alternative to lobster, the crawfish.
Alton goes on a historical and tasty exploration of tamales.
Alton Brown explores an American classic, spaghetti with meat sauce.
Looking for an alternative to chicken? Alton turns to pork tenderloin.
Alton tempts his niece into eating her vegetables with these tasty treats.
Alton begins his quest to return punch to its rightful culinary position.
Good Eats turns double digits and puts on a variety show to celebrate.
Alton helps an average Joe fix a classic breakfast: bacon, eggs and coffee.
Alton uses beer and wine as key ingredients in several tasty dishes.
As Lt. Steve Sloan and his partner, Cheryl, pick up their favorite strawberry milkshakes, Steve is distracted by a beautiful woman.
Calvin Laird, Mark and Steve's neighbor, threatens his girlfriend violently when she challenges his mean behavior. His repeated playing of loud music bothers the Sloans to no end.
A film school buddy of Alex's is at Community General Hospital making a documentary about the legend of a ghost in the basement.
When a hit-and-run patient mysteriously dies in the hospital, Dr. Sloan and his interns, Jack and Amanda, put their amateur crime solving abilities to the test.
A mobster's gun moll fakes her way past hospital security guards, and Dr. Sloan almost becomes her next victim! Attractive and smart, no one suspected Amy Westin's true identity.

Tonight, of all nights, Murphy's Law is definitely operating at its worst! After finally finagling all the details to put together a money-raising telethon for the hospital, Dr. Sloan loses his cool when the host of the show is murdered - on the air!
A late night call for help sends Dr. Sloan racing to the rescue! Ninety-two-year-old millionaire Jonathan Nash fears for his life.
A supposed 'ticket to heaven' leads to a trail of greedy scam artists and gamblers! Dying of a gunshot wounds, a man gives Dr. Sloan a winning lottery ticket.

A 'perfect cover' becomes a foul frame-up when Steve Sloan is accused of murder! Staging various crimes in their off-hours with perfect success, four corrupt police officers think they have it made - until one of them commits a homicide.

A 'perfect cover' becomes a foul frame-up when Steve Sloan is accused of murder! Staging various crimes in their off-hours with perfect success, four corrupt police officers think they have it made - until one of them commits a homicide.

A box of mutilated flowers and slashed photos drives pop-singer Shanda into a state of shock. After she collapses and her road tour grinds to a halt, Dr. Mark Sloan takes pity on Shanda and embarks on a search to find her mysterious stalker.

Still groggy from a visit to the dentist, Dr. Sloan is mystified when a noted fund-raiser dies while visiting his home. Adding to the confusion, the body mysteriously disappears before the police get there!
Dr. Sloan's free tickets to a friend's magic show become an invitation to murder when the magician mysteriously dies on stage in the middle of his escape act!

A romance in bloom is nipped in the bud when Steve's new girlfriend is charged with murder. An instructor of modern dance, Cindy is shocked to learn she's being charged with killing one of the owners of the studio where she works.
A cruel collage prank comes back to haunt four young women in later life. Although Amanda had almost forgotten it, a recent letter brings back the unpleasant memory.
Surprise, surprise! While investigating the murder of a call-girl, Dr. Sloan is caught in the middle of a vice raid!

Dr. Sloan becomes involved in more than politics when he accepts an invitation to attend an election campaign party. A face in a crowd of well-wishers awakens old memories for Mayor Ridgeway's wife, Lauren, with murderous results.

programmes.st: Destiny of the Daleks: Part Four
programmes.d: The Doctor discovers that the Daleks need Davros to break the stalemate in their war with the Movellans.
While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion.
Scarlioni is planning to steal the Mona Lisa. Yet he has six in his cellar - all genuine.
Count Scarlioni is really Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth.
Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction.
While under the influence of the evil Mara, Tegan redirects the Tardis to the Mara's former home planet.
The Doctor begins to unravel the legend of the Little Mind's Eye crystal; Tegan remains under the Mara's control as it attempts to regain its hold over the planet Manussa.
Chela takes the Doctor's fears seriously and tells him the snake dancer Dojjen can aid him in defeating the Mara.
The Doctor and the original snake dancer Dojjen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part One
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor escapes Adrasta by going into the mine, but there's something lurking inside.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor makes contact with the creature and realizes that all is not as it seems.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Four
programmes.d: The truth of Adrasta's scheme is revealed, but a terrible retribution is already in motion.
(1/4) A hyperspace accident results in two ships fusing together and releasing a deadly menace.
(2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.
(3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.
(4/4) Unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part One
programmes.d: With the TARDIS disabled, the Doctor is powerless to act when Romana is kidnapped.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor attempts to repair the TARDIS so that he can come to Romana's rescue.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana suspect that the Nimon are a small part of a large invasion.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Four
programmes.d: On Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon's empty promises.
When an old mysterious book enters his life, everything changes for young Chris Parsons.
The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive, a tourist attraction on the planet Argolis.
The Doctor and Romana track down the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive.
The Tachyon Recreation Generator ages the Doctor into a white haired old man.
The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future and strike back at the Foamasi.
Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from Tigella.
Posing as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella.
Meglos escapes with the Dodecahedron and the Doctor is mistakenly held responsible.
The Doctor must prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy Tigella.
What has become of Gallifrey? Who are the marauding Outlers? What lurks beneath the marsh?
A French bulldog is nervous around other dogs and occasionally nips at people; a Vizsla who resists going outside due to her fear of cars.
A couple's Chihuahua mix terrorizes their mastiff and dominates the house; a pit bull is not growing out of his puppy behavior.
An aggressive English bulldog/Lab mix; a cocker spaniel with a life-threatening appetite for paper products.
A Labrador mix with dog aggression; a Jack Russell terrier and a Queensland heeler whose formerly cordial relationship has become hostile.
A Maltese hates being on his leash; an American Eskimo barks and circles strangers who enter the house; a Nova Scotia duck tolling retriever with a fear of pools.
A pit bull/chow mix has an extreme fear of the stove; a Rottweiler and a German shepherd battle for control; a Jack Russell terrier cannot handle the loss of its pack leader.
A family's new Great Dane moves in on its other dog's territory; Cesar helps Los Angeles' animal-control department with its new pet-ownership program.
TV personality Ed McMahon has an aggressive wheaten terrier; a beagle does not leave the house; an Australian shepherd is so territorial no one has visited his home in years.
A widow's retriever mix and two fox terriers do not get along; a Shar-Pei/Doberman mix drools excessively on car rides; Cesar revisits a Rottweiler mix.
After a 45-day stint in Iraq and two hurricanes, an explosive-sniffing ATF Labrador retriever begins exhibiting severe symptoms of terror.
Cesar Millan helps an overly aggressive German shepherd and a timid rat terrier.
Cesar tries to help bring peace to Jennifer Lee Pryor's home, where fights have been breaking out among foster dogs and her own four dogs; an aggressive beagle.
A Yorkshire terrier who became aggressive after going blind; a spoiled Pekingese/miniature poodle mix; a Rottweiler with a dangerous obsession with the horses on the ranch where she lives.
A Lab-greyhound mix has aggression problems; a Rhodesian Ridgeback-boxer mix has severe dog aggression.
A Yorkshire terrier barks too much; a once-shy German shepherd becomes aggressive; a shepherd mix has a whining problem.
Cesar tries to help an aggressive Shiba Inu from Japan and meets a wire fox terrier who has a fixation with a riding lawn-mower.
Cesar revisits some of his toughest cases and sees how being on the show changed not only the dogs, but the lives of the owners.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.
Dorothy, Myra, and Grace go back to look for Mike; Preston plots to build a hotel-casino with help from his partner, Jake.
Dr. Mike worries that she cannot have a child, as Colorado Springs prepares for a Thanksgiving feast.
Dr. Mike fears she is unable to have a child because of her age; the townspeople debate sharing their feast with the Cheyenne on the reservation.
Dr. Mike searches for her prince charming on Halloween, while also helping an ailing patient.
Dr. Mike's Christmas present from her mother nearly destroys her home, and Brian discovers romance.
An ailing young stranger brings new life to town, but only Dr. Mike can save him.
Matthew decides to run for sheriff after Colorado Springs is hit by a crime wave.
Matthew, the new town sheriff, falls in love with the wrong kind of woman.
The residents of Colorado Springs are suckered into a financing scam.
Sully leads the rescue when a boy is kidnapped by a mountain man; Dr. Mike's pregnancy is in danger when she does not take care of herself.
Sully leaves the unruly rescue party to hunt for Matthew on his own; Dr. Mike's least favorite physician takes over her practice.
When the Rev. Johnson finds that his former mentor plans a visit, he borrows money from Hank to fix up his ramshackle church.
Emotions run high when a drifter is convicted of rape and murder.
The opening of a school on the Indian reservation becomes the subject of bitter controversy.
Dr. Mike’s dearest college friend comes to town, and their old competitiveness begins again.
Dr. Mike is nominated for Colorado’s woman of the year.
Medical emergencies keep Dr. Mike from cutting back on her hours in the clinic pending the birth of her baby.

A passionate weekend leads Alexis to accept Sean's impulsive marriage proposal; Sammy Jo gives into Josh Harris' passionate advances; celebrating Blake's primary election victory, Adam tells Blake he is going to have another grandchild.

Blake asks Steven to Run Denver-Carrington; Leslie succeeds in seducing Jeff; Sammy Jo struggles with her lingering love for Steven and her passion for Josh, as Josh is consumed by his cocaine addiction.

Alexis schemes to prevent Dana from legally adopting Adam's surrogate child; Adam anonymously informs the press of drug problems on Steven's football team; Steven discovers a powerful secret in Dana's past.

Sean threatens Dana with blackmail unless she helps him gather incriminating information against the Carrington family; Josh Harris is devastated by Sammy Jo's rejection of his wedding proposal; Fallon asks Jeff for a divorce.

After meeting with Cora Van Husen, Krystle obtains a copy of the scandalous video, proving Blake's innocence; Dex discovers Sean is somehow involved with unsavory characters proposing a multi-million dollar oil venture to Denver-Carrington.

Following Josh Harris' death, Sammy Jo realizes she must let go of Steven; upset by Steven's uncompromising use of power, Fallon drifts further away from her brother; Dana gives the notes of Denver-Carrington's board meeting to Sean.

Sean uses Alexis' bid for governor to gain control of Colbyco; Sammy Jo and Jeff develop a deep friendship from their mutual loneliness; Dana tells Adam he was the father of her aborted baby. As Adams turns to Karen for solace.

Krystle discovers damaging information regarding Alexis' marriage to Cecil Colby, Leslie follows Sean to his father's grave, learning his true identity as Joseph Aynders' son; Dana returns to Adam and the two quietly forget the past.

Forced by Adam and Fallon's vote, Steven reluctantly agrees to authorize the Vitron oil deal, as Sean's maniacal scheme to avenge his father's death begins to unfold; Krystle obtains a copy of Cecil Colby's original will.

Encouraged by her popular support after the shooting, Alexis decides to stay in the race; Sean speeds up his plan to use the Vitron oil deal to crush Alexis; Karen is unnerved by the return of her ex-husband.

Tired of Leslie's threats to expose his true identity, Sean plants a poisonous snake in her room as a warning of who she is dealing with; having second thoughts about accepting Adam's bribe to stay away from Karen, Jesse gives the money back.

Karen is rushed to the hospital as she goes into labor; after Sean threatens Leslie, she confides in Dex, Sean's true identity; Dex warns Alexis that Sean may be seeking vengeance against her as she listens in horror.
Alexis warns Blake about Sean's true identity. Concerned for his family's safety, Blake and Dex go to Natumbre to uncover Sean's mysterious scheme involving the Vitron oil deal.
Following the explosion in Natumbre, Blake is accused of dealing in illegal arms; Alexis uncovers proof that Sean paid Jesse to return to Denver so he could persuade Karen to keep Adam's baby.

Dana tries desperately to convince Adam how much she wants their son. She proposes that if they were a loving couple again, the judge would find in their favor. Still hurting from her outburst in court, Adam is cold to her pleas.
Adam is absolved of suspicion in the kidnapping of his son when Leslie calls him to say that Sean has taken the baby and is holding her captive. Adam and Steven hurry to the desolate mountain cabin.

Following Sean's death, Alexis is comforted by Dex's solace and friendship, as the two renew their passionate love for each other; Jeff and Sammy Jo are horrified to find her diary and a dead body in the water.
Jess dreams about people who have disappeared and is teamed with an FBI agent to find a Senator's missing fiancée.
Brooke and Jess investigate the disappearance of an FBI cadet.
Jess battles insomnia; pressure builds to find a serial killer's next victim before time runs out.
Parents of a teenage girl disappear from a highway gas station.
Janelle and Dondre can't seem to hide their true feelings; alliances at High Water are challenged.
Sage's troubles start trending; Dondre discovers that Janelle has been keeping a secret from him.
Odalie finds out why Davis has been skipping class; King's loyalties are torn; Tal finally makes a move on his crush.
Cam has big ideas for the Calloway Philanthropic Trust's first fundraiser.
Cam takes his basketball ambition in a new direction; Chen gets the wrong idea about Cassie's new hobby; Missy makes a troubling discovery.
Cam and Allison take a road trip; Mary Charles has a problem with a museum donor; Reggie tries to get in on a deal with Chen.
Cam and Reggie discuss the future; Cassie seeks spiritual affirmation; Missy needs a favor from her parents.
Cassie catches up with an old friend; Cam and Reggie visit a school; Missy and Allison each receive some unsolicited advice.
Missy pressures Reggie to make a play for their independence; M-Chuck's satisfaction comes at the cost of Cassie's; Cam rebuffs Flaherty.

While facing her past, Grace gives Phil the opportunity to impress key church leadership; Lady Mae steps in to do damage control in Grace's absence, and she is forced to face Mac's ghost and her own stained reputation.

Bob Whitmore returns to Memphis, Tenn., to remind Grace that he is the one in charge and to encourage her to consider a new idea he has for Calvary; on a mission to uncover what's been going on between Noah and Grace, Charity makes a phone call.

The fractures between Bishop and Lady Mae deepen and old wounds are reopened as he considers an invitation to preach elsewhere; Grace struggles to keep her secret and the church under compartmentalized control.
When Grace confesses to her family, not all the Greenleafs are on her side; the situation is complicated by police, lies, affairs, and the interests of Harmony and Hope.
Autumn Night, a mysterious beauty with a harrowing past, washes up on shore of the Pynk seeking employment; Mercedes Sundayz, a night headlined by the club's OG, brings trouble.
The Pynk's annual car wash receives a visit from a surprising guest; Autumn's past comes back to haunt her; back at the club, deals are negotiated in the private booths.

The Ricardos are going back to New York in one week and Lucy is determined not to leave Hollywood with the proper souvenirs. She's already got a box full of memorabilia but she still wants more.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.
Chip Jackson of MGM asks Ricky to perform at a party but he refuses in favor of a deep-sea fishing retreat. Lucy has a better idea - she tells Mr. Jackson that Ricky would be glad to appear.
When Ricky makes a little money by selling his car, he forgets to tell his New York neighbors who drove out with him to Hollywood that he will buy their return train tickets.

Lucy, unaccustomed to train travel, is sure her trip to New York will be filled with intrigue and romance. When she hears that a jewel thief is on board, she sees herself as the possible heroine of the situation despite Ricky's admonitions to leave.

On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.

Ricky Ricardo's new fame leads to an invitation to appear on a television interview program. The live interview is to take place in their home and Ricky's new agent wants them to move to a more posh apartment.

Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.

Ricky finds Lucy exhausted after a trying day with little Ricky and insists it is time their son started nursery school. Lucy's protests are overridden and Ricky takes young Ricky to nursery school, but the baby comes down with tonsillitis.

Ricky is offered a European booking that is too important to refuse but he can't afford to take Lucy with him. Lucy is furious at the prospect of being left behind, and when Ricky wants to take Fred Mertz along as the tour manager, Ethel too, is incensed.

Lucy is unable to produce her birth certificate to get a passport for the Ricardos' and Mertzes' European jaunt. She calls her hometown for the birth certificate but discovers that none exists for her.
Fred's fear of becoming seasick threatens the Mertzes' and Ricardos' plans for Ricky's European band tour. They are all booked on the ocean liner Constitution for the trans-Atlantic voyage.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.

Lucy is jealous after Ricky dances with Angela Randall, an up-and-coming British actress. She gets Ricky away from her by going to the country estate of Sir Clive Richardson, a prominent English film producer, for a fox hunt he is hosting.

The Ricardos and Mertzes prepare to leave London for Paris, Lucy realizes that they will not have time to visit her ancestral land of Scotland. She was looking forward to seeking out members of the McGillicuddy clan, her distant relatives.
Equipped with an English-French dictionary, Lucy sets out to explore Paris and discover an artist whose paintings will become very valuable – she knows she has "the eye."

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Lucy goes on a hunger strike in order to get Ricky to buy an expensive dress from a famous French designer. He finally gives in but returns the dress when he discovers that Ethel smuggled her food while on the strike.

Fred, managing Ricky's band while on European tour, routes the musicians to Locarno instead of Lucerne. Ricky is distraught and Lucy suggests a hike in the Alps with the Mertzes to take his mind off his problems.

Fred Mertz, managing Ricky's European band tour, is very concerned over the expense incurred when he misrouted Ricky's band so he books second-class train passage for the overnight trip to Florence and a fourth-class hotel for their stay.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, "Bitter Grapes".

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Orson Welles is scheduled to perform for a benefit in Ricky's club. Ricky is worried that Lucy will foul things up if she is around so he decides to send her off to Florida.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Lucy has misplaced her and Ethel's train tickets to Florida and they must share a ride with strange Mrs. Grundy. Mrs Grundy's odd behavior becomes more troubling to Lucy and Ethel when they learn that an escaped hatchet murderess matches her description.

While on vacation in Florida, Lucy and Ethel go on a shopping spree and spend a whopping $140! To make sure that their wives don't repeat their spree Ricky and Fred take the ladies on their next fishing trip.

When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City.

When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock’ and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids.

“Laval tries to mount a rescue to save the Kings and Li’Ella, but Flinx accidentally thaws out Fangars trophy room, and they end up having to fight both the Hunters, Scorpions, Spiders, and Bats.“

Saddened to see his father distraught over the loss of the Map and his best friend Tormak, Flinx boldly sneaks off to confront Fangar on his own but falls into a clever trap.

The brutal murder of an ambitious, beauty contest hopeful taints the annual Reach for the Stars ceremonies. Matlock is reunited with an old girlfriend, Janet Masters, whose daughter, Morgan, is accused of the crime.
Ben Matlock accepts the most dangerous case of his career when he agrees to defend an inmate accused of murder – before a kangaroo court in a riot-torn prison.
Matlock must protect his own life while he’s in prison trying to defend his client. Meanwhile, Conrad tries to unravel the prison murder plot from outside the walls.
Albeit with some reluctance, Ben Matlock defends one of Atlanta’s most successful madams, Ann Rawls, when she is accused of murdering one of her working girls.
Unraveling the clues to a series of suspicious deaths, Matlock uncovers a greedy extortion business that’s turned quite nasty. Ben and Leanne are drawn into a case of three accidental deaths.
Matlock and his daughter Leanne discover that extortion is the key to three accidental deaths involving young women who make it a business of crying rape.
Matlock’s client is accused of killing his ambulance-chasing lawyer who specializes in cases of personal injury – especially when the injuries occur at a local amusement park.
A movie star is accused of murdering another movie star.

Matlock takes the case of Ken Wilson, convicted of murdering his wife, whose body was never found. Recently released from prison after seven years, Wilson sets out to find his missing wife but gets arrested again.

Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.

Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.
Ben Matlock has an unusual problem defending a young married couple accused of murdering the woman who gave birth to a baby they were prepared to adopt.

Matlock believes in the innocence of a man whose brainwashed son insists he saw his father kill the leader of his cult. Ben is the only hope left for a concerned father whose son, David, has been swept into a religious cult.

Legendary Milton Berle guest stars as Harvey Chase, an old-time comedian who calls upon his fan and friend Ben Matlock when he’s accused of murdering a popular, but foul-mouthed performer who’d been called in to replace him.
The serenity of historic Roanoke Island is shattered when a retired career soldier attempts to prove his late brother’s death was not a hunting accident, but murder.

Working with a young Deputy Sheriff, Conrad McMasters, Matlock begins to pick away at the pattern of cover-ups, exposing information about a money-laundering scheme, local corruption, and a tightly-knit group of drug dealers.

Ben Matlock flies out to Hollywood to defend a beautiful former actress, Catherine Welden, who formed a lucrative cosmetic business only to be accused of murdering an ex-lover who was blackmailing her.

Barney assumes the identity of a powerful psychic from a Caribbean island kingdom in order to hypnotize a defecting crime syndicate leader into revealing his super secret list of government officials on the take.
Enemy operative Kiri has kidnapped U.S. envoy Carl Wilson and has an imposter, Gort, who is impersonating him to discredit a U.S. trade agreement.

To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Phelps poses as the head of a Hollywood movie studio as part of the IMF plan to prevent a crime syndicate's takeover of the studio.
An American intelligence officer, Hughes, has defected to the enemy with the only copy of an encoded top-secret message.
Sal Mineo guest stars as a ruthless young operator who heads up an international narcotics ring which the IMF attempts to break up on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
The IMF hides a young prince from assassins by disguising him as a gypsy girl, then Paris sets out to betray the boy to his pursuers on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.

Carl Betz, Barbara Anderson, and Robert Conrad guest star alongside Jim Phelps who, with the aid of Barney's electronic wizardry, takes on the guise of a hot-shot pool hustler to break up an illegal gambling operation.
Jim Phelps poses as a master chess champion to trap a criminal with a near genius mentality and his mysterious boss.
The Impossible Missions Force is dispatched to Berlin's East Zone.

After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.
The Impossible Missions Force invades the intricate world of spies to protect an American double agent and comes up against a human time bomb.
The leaders of two underworld factions call a top-level meeting at a ski resort to set up a financial holding company capable of creating chaos within the national economy.
The Impossible Missions Force led by Jim Phelps (Peter Graves) sets out to persuade the trusted henchman of a crime syndicate leader to testify against his boss.
Recovering a million dollars in gold bullion is the job of the IMF.

programmes.st: Visit to a Conservatory for Plants
programmes.d: Mister Rogers plants a seed and visits a conservatory. King Friday orders Handyman Negri to sing a song about not being afraid. This makes the neighbors even more anxious about the “big thing” that is to arrive in the neighborhood.

Mister Rogers brings in a cat named Jimmy and remembers him as a kitten. He shows pictures of babies that have grown into adults. Everyone gathers at the castle just as the big thing rolls into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Growing a Plant from a Seed
programmes.d: Mister Rogers says that the bean plant he planted a few days ago has grown. Robert Troll is the only one who can communicate with the “big thing.” He learns that it wants a blanket; the blanket causes it to sprout a stem and leaves.

Mister Rogers plays games that require patience.  Purple Panda experiments with a powder that causes flowers to grow. Prince Tuesday wishes the powder to make him grow. Mister Rogers goes to see the Harlem Spiritual Ensemble practice.
Harriett Cow shares the plans for a play. Lady Aberlin is greeted by a ballet dancer who dances her around the Neighborhood. The dancer inspires Ana Platypus to be a ballerina in the school play.

programmes.st: How Sweaters and Sneakers Are Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers explains why he changes into a sweater and sneakers, and shows how people make sweaters and sneakers. Miss Paulificate brings Prince Tuesday's ragdoll to life by dancing with him. The neighbors decide their roles in a play.
Mister Rogers plays dress-up with wigs and glasses, and says: “You can get dressed up in the fanciest of things, but the best style comes from inside, and it often spreads on your face with a smile.”

King Friday suggests that the Neighborhood of Make-Believe be turned upside down to see if the missing crown might fall out. Trolley finds the spare crown! Mister Rogers visits the Boys Choir of Harlem.

Maggie Stewart is dressed as Mr. McFeely and delivers a film about how people make sweaters. The children put on a play about a princess, a raccoon and a giant king. Prince Tuesday admits he had something to do with the missing crown.

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow paint a portrait of Mr. McFeely. Robert Troll paints a portrait of King Friday who asks Lady Aberlin to have everyone copy it for themselves. Lady Aberlin explains that art comes from within each person.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers has a toy airplane
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a wooden toy airplane. Handyman Negri is working on a musical portrait of King Friday. Neighbor Aber provides his own tribute to King Friday as he mans his plane and draws a sky-written portrait of the King.

programmes.st: We all have art inside of us
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a picture of a blue tree. In art, you can make things any way you want. He also talks about visiting art museums.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers plays music by Mozart
programmes.d: Mister Rogers "colors a song" by playing music by Mozart to inspire his artwork. King Friday is curious about a delivery to X the Owl labelled "Deliver to X the Owl ONLY."

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow approaching with his imaginary dog.  Robert Troll and his imaginary pet, Gloria, are visiting with Queen Sara. When the Queen departs for a meeting, Gloria disappears into the castle.

Mister Rogers shows  a video about people who make umbrellas. It's raining in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe and Neighbor Aber is interested in a special sale at the factory where Corney has manufactured Umbrella Rockits.

Marilyn Barnett stops by for some sitting down exercises. Prince Tuesday asks Handyman Negri to help bring his ragdoll to life. Corney has made a new (imaginary) umbrella Rockit for Daniel's imaginary friend, Malcolm Apricot Dinko.

programmes.st: It's hard to learn new things
programmes.d: Mister Rogers delights in a visitor who can whistle, especially because that's something Mister Rogers hasn't been able to learn. Nobody can do everything!

Mister Rogers talks and sings about wondering and being curious, which is important for learning! Jazz saxophonist Eric Kloss, who is blind, shows how he uses a special machine called the Kurzweil Personal Reader!

Elevators and escalators - Mister Rogers shows some toy machines, and rides on real ones that lift people and cars. There's even a hydraulic platform delivered by Mr. McFeely in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

A domino display artist sets up thousands of dominoes. When one is knocked over, they all go down in a fascinating pattern. Lady Elaine's elevator in Make-Believe takes Robert Troll up in the air as if he's flying.

programmes.st: Up & Down: Many Things Go Up & Down
programmes.d: Flags, marbles, a slide – so many things go up and down. Mister Rogers learns some up and down exercises from Neighbor Marilyn Barnett and Kara, a young ballerina.

programmes.st: Up & Down: Visit with a Clarinetist
programmes.d: A visit with world famous clarinetist, Richard Stoltzman, who makes music playing notes that go up and down. In Make-Believe, there's hope that an elevator operator will solve the up and down problem at Lady Elaine's Museum-Go-Round.

Balloon artist, Bruce Franco, blows up balloons into animal shapes. It takes a lot of practice to be able to make fancy things like that from balloons. Then, Mr. McFeely and Mayor Maggie go up in the air for a hot-air balloon ride.

Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make stuffed bears. Mr. McFeely encounters someone dressed in a bear costume.  Daniel recognizes that the bear is a person in costume and realizes that person is Lady Aberlin.

Visiting the Neighborhood aviary, Mister Rogers sees a variety of birds. King Friday scolds his birds as they fail to meet his exercise expectations. Mayor Maggie invites the birds to join her as she goes to the new "Museum of Love."

Mister Rogers takes out a wooden block and talks about when he was young and would use a block to pretend he was shaving. At Negri's Music Shop, mandolinist Peter Ostroushko sings a Ukrainian lullaby.
Mister Rogers blows some bubbles and calls a plumber because the water in his house isn't working.

programmes.st: A Toy Trolley on the Tracks!
programmes.d: Prince Tuesday is concerned when he sees a small toy Trolley on the tracks. Robert Troll picks it up and tells the prince that the real Trolley is playing at Daniel's clock.  Daniel shares that the Trolley can do some "magical things."
Jim West, a shadow artist, creates silhouettes of various animals. King Friday asks Robert Troll to help him by return some shadows that were left behind at the castle by various Neighbors.

Every day three million passengers board the 10,000 aircraft flying at any given moment; go behind the scenes at international airports to see ground control towers, cargo holds, high-tech security and customs that make air travel possible.

It's the place where one man's trash is truly another man's treasure; enter the mysterious world of the junkyard, where many pieces actually do add up to a whole; uncover how junkyard operators create order out of seemingly random piles of junk.

Close to 40% of Earth is classified as desert, but these environments offer hope through Middle East desalination, Las Vegas communities, Hoover Dam power, irrigation agriculture, solar energy, and technology enabling future Mars colonization.

From the early "egg beaters" of World War II to the "flying tanks" of Operation Desert Storm, meet the first pilot to fly a combat rescue mission in WWII and a U.S.A.F. female aviator; and view classified footage of the Apache in Iraq.

Candy production consumes 7 billion tons yearly, evolving from handmade operations to high-tech mass production; explore Hershey's cocoa processing, See's boxed chocolates, Schimpff's traditional methods, and Jelly Belly's gourmet jellybeans.
Journey to the depths of a salt mine, speed across the Bonneville salt flats, and find out just what makes this mineral so unique.

Engineering disasters exact costs in lives when design flaws fail projects; examine the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Idaho's first nuclear accident, Soyuz 11 deaths, Texas Tower destruction, and NASA's Mars mission losses.
They block the force of a river, produce enough electricity to power cities, move water over hundreds of miles and irrigate fertile valleys.
From ancient solutions to the development of modern water and sewer services, plumbing helped to make civilization possible.

The minds of the off-kilter geniuses who thought up off-the-mark concepts; some tinkerers' musings were merely ahead of their time and deemed flops during the inventor's lifetime, but others were just plain bad.

Traveling some of the world's most dangerous roads, including Bolivia's "Death Road," California's fog-shrouded Highway 99, the road to Baghdad's airport and Colorado's Million Dollar Highway; highway safety; off-road drivers.
Entries and exits; world's tallest doors at the Vehicle Assembly Building at Kennedy Space Center; a company that makes blast doors and bulletproof doors; fabricating doors for homes.
Sinkholes; use of asbestos; Chang River flood; liquid natural-gas explosions; Hyatt Hotel walkway collapses.

programmes.st: Carpet Burns and a Bite Mark
programmes.d: Charlie is dismayed to learn that Alan's recent dating spree has been with Alan's ex-wife, Judith. Charlie fears he will rarely get to see Jake if Alan and Judith reconcile.
Alan infuriates Charlie when he gives Berta permission to move into the beach house for a couple of days. Charlie reprimands Alan and informs him that he's just a houseguest.

Dave's old nemesis comes back to haunt him when Beth replaces the lobby sandwich machine with a popular 1980's arcade game; Lisa retakes her college entrance exams to see if her mind is slipping.
It's up to Lisa and Dave to get the staff primed to attend Jimmy's annual Halloween party.

Maya and Jack square off over the advanced age of her new boyfriend; Nina's flirtatious behavior has unintended consequences for a handsome window washer.
Finch ignores all warnings and gets involved with Elliott's old girlfriend.
A request to get her father to stop his favoritism backfires and costs Maya a trip to London.

programmes.st: Have You Driven a Ford Lately
programmes.d: Al and Steve buy a beat up Ford Mustang off of one of Kelly's boyfriends. Soon they form a tight friendship while fixing it up like new. The only problem is they are neglecting their wives.
Steve and Marcy plan to add a new room onto their house using their tax refund money. Al convinces Steve to make it into a billiards room while Peggy convinces Marcy to make it into an exercise room.
Al gets a first-hand look at swinging bachelor life when he takes refuge at Luke's apartment after an argument with Peggy over visiting her relatives for the weekend.
To get the money to purchase a new VCR that Al won't buy her, Peggy takes a job in a department store selling clocks.
Carrie and Doug begin preparing for tax time and realize that their charitable giving leaves a little to be desired.
Carrie's attempt at a new hair-do, a bun a la 'The Librarian' - leaves Doug feeling completely turned off and not wanting to bring her to his upcoming class reunion.

When a city official is gunned down in Berryville, Virginia, shocked residents are left wondering who among them is a cold-blooded killer. As police dig into the victim's life, they learn not everyone held her in high regard.

Once a prosperous silver mining camp, Aspen evolved into a year-round mountain retreat for the rich and famous. It was a place where the powerful could forget the hustle and bustle of their hectic lives.

A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer.  His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived.  In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest.  A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them.  As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.
Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers.  Kidnapping is one of them.  No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

Women are most often assaulted by someone they know.  Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender.  Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

A girl goes missing in Ontario; police follow leads across three provinces to find her abductor and uncover the truth.
In 1979, Oregon Coastguardsman Ricky Hemphill was murdered, and Charla Toma vanished. Police link former convict Edward Warren to a bizarre plot.
A young man kills Dean Corll, exposing 27 murders in Houston and revealing he was Corll's unwilling accomplice.

programmes.st: Saying Goodbye and Descending from the Elephant! Setting Out to Take Back Sanji!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy's team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!

programmes.st: To the Reverie! Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi!
programmes.d: Luffy's team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn't realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for!

programmes.st: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
programmes.d: Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…

programmes.st: Kaido Returns! An Imminent Threat to the Worst Generation!
programmes.d: News of the raid on the Revolutionary Army reaches Luffy! But that's the least of their worries as they face a storm and a sudden lack of provisions! Meanwhile, Emperor Kaido fumes with anger at the reckless generation of upstarts!

programmes.st: A Hungry Front! Luffy and the Navy Rookies!
programmes.d: Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?

programmes.st: The Implacable Three! A Big Chase After the Straw Hats!
programmes.d: The jig is up as Luffy and the others make a daring dash to avoid the furious Navy! Can they escape without having to turn to fight - and after they've had a chance to raid the cabinets for food?

programmes.st: The Devil's Fist! A Show Down! Luffy vs. Grount!
programmes.d: Making a mad dash for the Submerge with the food they stole, Luffy and the others have to get through some of the Navy's upstart soldiers! Grount, whose arm holds incredible power, summons his training to challenge Luffy!

programmes.st: Sanji's Homecoming! Into Big Mom's Territory!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats continue to suffer from blazing heat and a perilous food crisis! As the seas finally calm, fishing is their only hope! Meanwhile, Sanji arrives in Big Mom's territory and keeps his cool - until he sees his bride-to-be!

Luffy is in danger as the venomous fish poison courses through his body! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a mysterious ship for help - a ship that bears a truly surprising crew!

programmes.st: A Deadly Poison Crisis! Luffy and Reiju!
programmes.d: On the edge of life and death, Luffy's only hope rests with Sanji's siblings! But even though they refuse to share an antidote, they may be able to save Luffy's life yet, giving him enough energy to plunge right back into trouble.

programmes.st: Totto Land! Emperor Big Mom Appears!
programmes.d: Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible!

programmes.st: The Emperor's Daughter! Sanji's fiancée - Pudding!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats confront Pudding - the fiancée of Sanji! But when they challenge her for Sanji's heart, her answer shocks them! Meanwhile, an ominous and mysterious message may spell doom for the Straw Hats.

programmes.st: A Massive Attack! Mom's Hunger Pangs!
programmes.d: The dangerous waters around the Whole Cake Island harbor terrifying creatures that pose a challenge for the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Mama slips into a bout of her sickness and ravages her own land in search of a specific pastry!

programmes.st: The Capital City Falls?! Big Mom and Jimbei!
programmes.d: Big Mom rampages through the Whole Cake Island in search for sweets - but when the kitchen can't prepare them fast enough, her own son steps in to curb the carnage, with deadly results.

programmes.st: The Emperor's Castle! Arriving at the Whole Cake Island!
programmes.d: As the Straw Hats draw closer to the Whole Cake Island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom's territory - and hatches a plan to win back Sanji and take an item of great worth from the Emperor!

programmes.st: A Mysterious Forest Full of Candies! Luffy vs. Luffy?!
programmes.d: Brook and Pedro head out in a submersible to infiltrate Big Mom's stronghold! Meanwhile, Luffy, Nami, Chopper and Carrot head into the island chasing the image of Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy!

programmes.st: Mom's Assassin! Luffy and the Seducing Woods!
programmes.d: Lost in the bewildering woods and chasing after Sanji, Nami and the others find there's more than meets the eye in this upside down part of the Whole Cake Island! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his brother!

programmes.st: A Seafaring Kingdom! Germa's King Judge!
programmes.d: Luffy continues to move through the mysterious and dangerous woods, unaware of the danger that lurks in the trees! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his father as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare!

programmes.st: A Battle Between Father and Son! Judge vs. Sanji!
programmes.d: Sanji faces off against his father in a duel! His powerful kicks aim at protecting his hands, but the Germa Family has more in store for him yet! Meanwhile, Luffy goes deeper into the Seducing Woods and falls for their powerful illusions!

programmes.st: A Giant Ambition! Big Mom and Caesar!
programmes.d: Big Mom has Caesar Clown at her whims - and despite his bilking her out of countless amounts of money - she is ready to continue her pursuit of maniacal world control!

programmes.st: The Land of Souls! Mom's Fatal Ability!
programmes.d: Finally, Nami finds Luffy and recounts her harrowing tale of battling Brulee! Meanwhile, the mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his true identity! But this must all be put aside when one of Mom's most powerful generals comes calling!

programmes.st: A Top Officer! The Sweet 3 General Cracker Appears!
programmes.d: The identity of the enigmatic Pound, the man half-buried in the woods, is revealed, but his deep connection to Big Mom might not be enough to save him! Nami's past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping Mom's minions at bay!

programmes.st: An Enemy Worth 800 million! Luffy vs. Thousand Armed Cracker!
programmes.d: Luffy squares off against Cracker, one of the Sweet 3 Generals, as Nami learns the truth about others in the Worst Generation who have come before to challenge Big Mom!

programmes.st: An All-out Duel! Gear Four vs. the Bis-Bis Ability
programmes.d: Luffy continues to fight against Cracker, whose powers to manipulate his surroundings may prove more troublesome than he had thought! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate the Whole Cake Island - and must hatch a plan to avoid getting caught!

programmes.st: The First and the Second Join! The Vinsmoke Family!
programmes.d: The wind starts to go out of Luffy's sails as he fights an endless army of Biscuit Warriors! Meanwhile, the oldest two Vinsmoke brothers come home from a war to see their long-missing young brother Sanji.

programmes.st: The Benefactor's Life! Sanji and Owner Zeff!
programmes.d: Luffy starts to run out of steam as the Biscuit Warriors keep multiplying! If he can buy himself 10 minutes to recharge…

programmes.st: An Angry Sanji! The Secret of Germa 66!
programmes.d: Luffy needs just 10 minutes to recharge! Nami comes to rescue with the help of the Homies! Meanwhile, Sanji learns the terrible truth of Germa's power - and his father's dark history!

programmes.st: The Past that He Let Go of! Vinsmoke Sanji!
programmes.d: Nami challenges Cracker on her own! During the all-out fight, she loses her advantage and is close to defeat. Can Luffy bounce back in time? Meanwhile, Sanji's tragic childhood is made clear.

programmes.st: To the East Blue! Sanji's Resolute Departure!
programmes.d: The terrible history of Sanji's family continue to unfold. From a rare moment of compassion, he is able to escape, only to face his father's cruelty before setting out on his own.

programmes.st: A Battle of Limits! Luffy and the Infinite Biscuits!
programmes.d: Luffy is in an all-out, all-you-can-eat battle! As Cracker's endless stream of Biscuit Warriors marches on, Luffy's endless appetite is put to the test. Meanwhile, Reiju helps Sanji to straighten himself out before he meets his fiancée.

programmes.st: The Power of Satiety! A New Gear Four Form - Tank Man!
programmes.d: Luffy needs to think fast in order to turn the battle in his favor - filled with biscuits, he debuts a new Gear Four attack that has lasting repercussions! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot find Sanji's reflection, but can they get a message to him in time?

programmes.st: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 1
programmes.d: Luffy finally catches up with Sanji! However, as a happy past plays before his eyes in which he, Sanji, and the crew deepened their bonds, a new page is turning in the history of the Straw Hats.

programmes.st: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 2
programmes.d: Sanji's journey with the crew looks to be coming to an end!

A cat-loving and recently divorced young woman dipping her toes back in the dating game is beaten and strangled in a brutal and unusual way; investigators dive into the murky world of online dating to hunt a killer who could be ready to strike again.

Detectives discover the badly beaten body of a single young woman left bizarrely staged on her bed; fear in the community grows amid a rash of nearby murders until police are handed a break when a fresh look at old evidence points to the killer.

Roy shows his nephew what being an instigator is all about at an auction in South Etobicoke. Bogart wants a new catch-phrase. Rick's pirate shtick grates on Cindy's nerves, but that's nothing compared to what they get from director Kenny Hotz.

Bogart's hooked on goji berry juice and plans to spread the word at an auction in Milton. Roy is in all white, looking to spread distraction. Cindy's mind is on the lockers, but Rick's is in the gutter. Ursula has a bonsai to pick with her locker.

Roy distracts other buyers by invading their personal space at an auction in Mississauga. Paul and Bogart are clueless at finding a gift for Bogart's fiancée. Rick and Cindy regret arriving on rollerblades and Ursula has a horrific hair day.

Roy makes mischief at an auction in Toronto with an assortment of classic pranks. Rick and Cindy resort to flashing to grab Don's attention. Ursula vows to take the perfect selfie, and Paul decides Bogart is finally ready for “the talk."
Danger, lies, and murder ensue for a professional assassin on a job in a remote town in this noir thriller starring Anson Mount, Abbie Cornish, and Oscar® winner Anthony Hopkins.

A delightful comedy starring Jon Hamm as the charming Fletch, who becomes the prime suspect in a murder case while searching for a stolen art collection. He turns his focus to an eccentric cast of characters to determine whodunit and clear his name.
In Nebraska City, 1991, two best friends get the chance to run the swimming pool snack shack, which later becomes the perfect setting for transgression, fun, personal discovery, and romance.
A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.
A professional hitman faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings.
In this thrilling WWII epic, a US pilot shot down over Germany must singlehandedly battle Nazi troops to thwart a doomsday plot involving a superbomb that can destroy whole cities.

programmes.t: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
programmes.d: With unraveled embroidery and fraying hems, the pants are back for another glorious summer that four now college-aged friends will never forget.
In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.
In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.
From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

Louis and Leopold compete for control of Spain.

The Musketeers are dispatched to Le Havre to collect the infamous merchant trader Bonnaire and bring him back to Paris to be reprimanded for breaking France's trade treaty. The mission soon descends into a treacherous battle.

Aramis' loyalty to the Musketeer regiment is tested when he agrees to help his old friend Marsac uncover the truth behind a mission. Marsac believes he knows the truth behind the infamous massacre which killed his troop and wants Aramis' help to prove it.

Porthos returns to the dangerous streets of his youth when he's unjustly charged with murder. In order to save him, the Musketeers must prove his innocence. Their investigations uncover a tangled web of divided loyalties and greed.

Aramis and d'Artagnan are thwarted in their task to transport a young woman and her baby from a village outside Paris to the Palace when armed men abduct her baby. They must find out who she is and why anyone would go to such lengths to kidnap her son.

Following the death of a young girl, The Musketeers' investigation into her missing friend leads them to the world of a high-born woman. They put aside their animosity towards Cardinal when his life is placed in danger and rescue this extraordinary woman.

When Mary learns of a secret clause in her marriage contract that her mother, Marie de Guise and Queen Catherine orchestrated, Mary and Francis embark on a dangerous plan to turn Scotland against her mother.
When Mary's brother James arrives in France and convinces Mary to return to Scotland, Francis is suspicious and uncovers a plot that would destroy Mary, which causes a rift between them.

When Mary's uncle, the Duke of Guise, arrives in France with devastating news about her mother, Mary and Francis realize they are torn between putting their own countries first or saving their marriage.

Mary enlists a mercenary to help her, which forces her to realize there are sacrifices and lives she is willing to risk to save her country.  Francis embraces his role as Dauphin to lead France in a brutal battle against England.

Mary and Catherine form an unlikely alliance when deciding how to deal with the increasingly manic King Henry, which puts Francis in jeopardy. Bash finds a boy who lived to tell about his encounter with the Darkness.

When the King's madness and cruelty reaches a fevered pitch, Mary and Francis take action. Their choices could change the course of history, but an unforeseen terror brewing in the woods could cost them, and their friends, everything.

The new King and Queen of France, Francis and Mary are plummeted into chaos after the Black Plague ravages the land and creeps inside the castle, threatening lives and the stability of their new rule.
In the aftermath of the plague, a powerful lord discovers that Mary was responsible for the death of his son and demands vengeance, testing the loyalties of Mary, Francis and Catherine.
With France in a state of famine, as well as religious and political unrest, Mary looks for a way to feed the people, risking the wrath of a vengeful Lord Narcisse.
As the Fringe team continues to fight the Observers, unforeseen events lead them into a forest, where they encounter a strange subculture devoted to recording human history.

programmes.d: When the Fringe Team tracks a lead into a hostile and heavily guarded location, Phillip Broyles (series star LANCE REDDICK) resurfaces… but can he be trusted?
The Fringe Team goes on the offensive.
