Warren leads an attack against Murphytown to extract its smug leader.
Addy is being pummeled with whatever The Man can throw at herU+00A0 and Lucy does the same right back.
Two years later, things have gotten worse: Warren's apocalyptic dreams continue while the group fights MAD-Zs.
After consuming the brain of a matchmaker, Liv tires to find a match for Major.  Meanwhile, Blaine will stoop to any level to protect himself, and Don E considers an offer.
Liv consumes the brain of a chef at a high-end restaurant, and she becomes an unrelenting perfectionist.
Liv and Ravi consume the brain of a very dislikable car salesman and inherit his competitive nature.
Liv and Clive investigate the murder of a beauty pageant contestant who went into anaphylactic shock onstage in 1999.
Trying to recall his plan, Walter takes an LSD trip down memory lane.  Meanwhile, Peter and Olivia trace a mysterious signal into the woods, where they come upon a grisly scene.
As Peter, Olivia, Astrid and Walter scramble to tap into a key piece of the puzzle to defeat the Observers, they enlist the aid of Nina Sharp who conjures up a plan.
Walter enters the lab's deprivation tank to uncover information about the mysterious Donald, while Windmark sets out on a revealing mission of his own.
Emily understands why we explore through the eyes of astronauts, entrepreneurs, and inventors.
Xploration Outer Space names The Top 20 Greatest Moments in Space: Caught on Video.
Emily discovers the products by the NASA space program that have made everyday life better on Earth.
Emily Calandrelli explores the unique world of Space Camp in Huntsville, AL.
Emily & astronaut Jon McBride discover how amusement park rides can be just like space travel.
Emily Calandrelli uncovers the most prominent disasters in space exploration & the lessons learned.
Emily Calandrelli makes the case for space exploration and why we should explore beyond our planet.
Join host Emily Calandrelli as she explores the fascinating world of exoplanets.
Richard Hammond reveals the surprising engineering connections in NASA’s Space Shuttle – the world’s first reusable spacecraft.
Richard Hammond reveals the surprising engineering connections behind the glamorous appearances of the Formula 1 car.
Richard Hammond checks out the world’s tallest and most distinctively shaped hotel – the 320 metre high Burj al Arab, or Arabian Tower.
Richard Hammond reveals the surprising engineering connections in Japan’s Bullet Train – the world’s first high-speed train.
Humans refine and evolve weapons designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.
Pioneering breakthroughs from across the globe shape the ability to travel.
The first data-recording device from over 5,000 years ago; how weaving creates binary code.
From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of priorities.

Mars our closest neighbor now a lifeless planet – but it may once have had water and therefore life. Naked Science investigates the red planet to learn how it was formed, how it became barren, and ask whether it ever will be possible to colonize it?

Saturn is the second-largest planet in the solar system. Storms on this gas giant can cover an area bigger than the United States Clouds of the gas race around the planet at over 1000 miles per hour generating fierce electrical storms and lightning.

programmes.st: The Big Bang - The First Three Seconds
programmes.d: 13.7 billion years ago there was absolutely nothing. No space, no time, and no matter. Naked Science follows the first three seconds of creation when a speck of light appeared from nothing and rapidly expanded into an enormous Universe.

programmes.t: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programmes.d: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.
In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!
Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).
DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: This thriller follows Heather and Carla, who meet after not having spoken in years. Heather is about to present a very unexpected proposition that could change their lives forever.

Jim Morrison, one of the most sensual figures in the history of rock and roll, explodes on the screen in “THE DOORS,” the electrifying movie about a time called the sixties and a legendary outlaw who rocked America’s consciousness – forever.

AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.
Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.
Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13
In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.
A haunted young woman spirals into confusion and chaos after she falls under the spell of a potent reality-altering drug.

For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams: the Pet Sematary.

Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

An emotionally charged action-adventure tale of a retired climber (O'Donnell) who must launch a treacherous and extraordinary rescue effort up K2, the world's second-highest peak, to save his estranged sister and her summit team in a race against time.

A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.
Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.
Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.
Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.
Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

Defiance is a riveting adventure that showcases the extraordinary true story of the Bielski brothers, simple farmers -outnumbered and outgunned- who turned a group of war refugees into powerful freedom fighters.

Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike anything the world has ever seen.
An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.
Police investigate the murder of a husband and his pregnant wife.

The Enterprise C enters the Enterprise D's time and space continuum, where they find Picard and crew in a constant state of war with the Klingons, and only Guinan knows it.

Picard is kidnapped and held with three different aliens and meanwhile replaced with a replica as impostor captain.

When transporting a dangerous material to the Enterprise, Data is kidnapped and the crew is led to believe he is dead when the shuttlecraft he was piloting explodes enroute.

Tom and B'Elanna's relationship could be the loser when Tom enters a race.

While testing a newly repaired puddle jumper, McKay and Captain Hugh Griffin suddenly lose control of the ship and crash into the ocean. As the jumper begins to sink slowly towards the bottom of the ocean, Griffin sacrifices himself to save McKay.

Sheppard and the team discover a world that has technology created by the Ancients. But the planet's royal family does not allow anyone but them to harness the technology and treat the villagers with little dignity.

The team discover two life pods floating in space. Upon further investigation, the team accidentally transfers the minds of the individuals into Sheppard and Weir. Things get worse when the team discovers the two people are out to destroy the other.

With the Destiny still out of power, a plan is born to abandon the ship using the last working shuttle, in hopes that another planet will be habitable. But hope is short-lived when the only way to determine who will go and who will stay is a lottery.

Despite severe rationing and around-the-clock security, the water reserves onboard the Destiny continue to drop. Dr. Nicholas Rush has no explanation for this latest setback but, if they are to survive, they must find a new water source soon.

With the situation onboard the Destiny dire, General O’Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and Homeworld Command order Col. Young to execute a high-risk plan concocted by the IOA scientists which, in theory, could return the crew to Earth.

After making a surprising discovery on a jungle planet, members of the team become ill. In an attempt to isolate the infection, the team sets up camp in the jungle. But when night falls, the illness will be the least of their worries.

Daniel experiences strange dreams centered around his possible knowledge of the Lost City of the Ancients. Suspicious that Daniel's mind is being manipulated, the team must find a way to help him while keeping the secret from the Goa'uld.

Carter flees from a super warrior with a piece of technology that may be the key to defeating Anubis's new army. Injured and unarmed, Carter must use all her training to stay alive, while O'Neill and Teal'c race to find her before it's too late.

When the Air Force sends a documentary crew to capture the historical importance of the Stargate program, the members of the SGC are resistant. Tensions rise when an emergency forces General Hammond to restrict the access they're given to the SGC.

Assigned the task of capturing the importance of the Stargate program, a documentary crew is given a true look at the heroic nature and family-like bond of the soldiers of Stargate Command, when a key member of the SGC is killed in action.

SG-1 is sent to investigate the murder of a group of rogue NID scientists. They discover that results of the scientists' experiments may have combined DNA to create the ultimate evil: a human being that possesses the conscience of a Goa'uld.

On his first day in office, the newly elected president of the United States is told about the Stargate program and must be brought up to speed on the past seven years of its existence. Starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

O'Neill allows the knowledge of the Ancients to be downloaded into his mind again, even though the first time almost killed him. While he slowly deteriorates, he and SG-1 must race against time to uncover the secret of the Lost City of the Ancients.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programmes.d: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house.  Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella.  Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy.  Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business.  The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programmes.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programmes.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions.  Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing.  Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract.  The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid.  The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home.  Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Goes To School
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read.  When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programmes.t: Floyd Mayweather vs Carlos Alberto Ramon Rios
programmes.d: On February 17th, 1999, Floyd Mayweather fought Carlos Rios for the WBC Super Featherweight Title in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Rios was a tough opponent for Mayweather, but Mayweather prevailed and showed out in front of his hometown, winning by UD.

On May 22nd, 2004 Floyd Mayweather fought DeMarcus Corley at the Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City for the WBC World Light Welterweight Title eliminator with Corely going down in round 8 and round 10 resulting in a win for Mayweather.

On January 20th, 2001 Floyd Mayweather faced Diego Corrales in a battle for the WBC World super feather weight titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas ending in a technical knockout victory for Mayweather.

On January 9th, 1998, Floyd Mayweather fought Hector Arroyo in a featherweight bout in Biloxi, Mississippi. A young Mayweather hungry for a title shot came out quick against Arroyo, stopping him in the fifth round of the fight.

On June 14th, 1997, Floyd Mayweather fought Larry O'Shields in a lightweight bout at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas. A young Mayweather showed his impressive speed and agility, earning a unanimous decision victory.

On May 2nd, 2015, Floyd Mayweather fought Manny Pacquiao in what was labeled as the "Fight of the Century." Floyd Mayweather emerged victorious via a unanimous decision, showcasing his exceptional defensive skills against Pacquiao's aggressive style.

On November 1st, 2003 Floyd Mayweather and Phillip N'dou fought eachother for the WBC world lightweight title at the Van Andel Arena in Grand Rapids with Mayweather ending the bout early for a technical knockout victory

On April 8th, 2006, Floyd Mayweather fought Zab Judah for the IBF and IBO Welterweight Titles at Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. In a fight with a dramatic melee in round 10, Mayweather cruised in the later rounds to win by unanimous decision.
On August 9th, 1984, Freddie Roach fought Joe Ruelaz in a super featherweight bout in Las Vegas. The more experienced Roach made easy work of Ruelaz, stopping him in the fourth round.

A heat wave hits LA and the gang heads for the beach in Beck's RV. But once there, they find themselves trapped inside the RV as the temperature rises. Oblivious, Cat parties it up with some cute boys.
Tori's flight home is delayed, leaving her no time to finish a school project with her friends. She attempts to get the work done with them over video chat, but things keep getting in the way.

Tori's friends sing at a local karaoke club and end up competing with a pair of stuck-up girls who are regular performers there. Competing with those girls proves to be more difficult than they expect, since one of the girls' father owns the club.
Tori auditions for a role in a movie. But after exaggerating on her resume, she gets hired as a stunt double. When Tori finds out her stunt is falling off a building, she's not sure she can do it.
When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade.  Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.
The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

programmes.t: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?
programmes.d: Trina stars in Tori's directorial debut, and there is a big accident on opening night. Lane wants to find out what went wrong. Everyone thinks it was an equipment malfunction, maybe it's sabotage.

Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?
Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?
The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?
The kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other, because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz!
Tori and the gang are forced to spend a Saturday in detention after a lunch trip gone wrong. They have the whole day to learn about each other, find food, and try not to earn more detention.
Jade and Beck help Sinjin with his new game show, "The Worst Couple," but it puts their relationship to the test.  Meanwhile, Tori breaks her precious Pear Phone.
Tori notices some changes in her friend Andre, whose girlfriend seems to be overbearing and controlling. Meanwhile, Jade and Cat try to earn easy money dog-sitting in Beverly Hills.
Cat's favorite actress dies and she talks Tori and Jade into driving to the actress' house to hold a vigil. Meanwhile, Trina directs a play starring herself, with Beck, Andre, and Robbie.
Tori and Jade play a married couple putting their acting abilities and uneasy friendship to the test. Meanwhile, Cat & Robbie start a service where they deliver bad news in a friendly way.
In an effort to take more risks as an actress, Tori goes to an underground spot called "The Gorilla Club."  Meanwhile, Andre and Robbie lose a very interesting bet to Jade.

programmes.t: Classic Doctor Who: The Leisure Hive

(4/4) What is the legacy of Dexter's research? How does the Doctor give evolution a small nudge?

programmes.d: (1/4) The TARDIS lands on a world where the inhabitants live in fear of the Three Who Rule.

programmes.t: Classic Doctor Who: State of Decay
programmes.d: (2/4) The Doctor and Romana are taken to the tower and meet the three mysterious rulers.

programmes.t: Classic Doctor Who: State of Decay
programmes.d: (3/4) The Doctor discovers that he is facing an unstoppable foe from Time Lord history.

programmes.t: Classic Doctor Who: State of Decay
programmes.d: (4/4) The Great Vampire begins to awaken from his long sleep...
(1/4) The TARDIS is drawn into an empty void, but they are not the only ones trapped there.
(2/4) When Rorvik learns that Romana is a time sensitive, he takes her prisoner.
(3/4) As the void shrinks, Rorvik plans to take desperate measures to escape via the mirror.
(4/4) Rorvik ignores the Doctor's warnings and takes a gamble which may have fatal consequences.
(1/4) The Keeper of Traken appears in the TARDIS seeking the Doctor's help.
(2/4) The Traken Consul hold Adric and the Doctor under sentence of death.
(3/4) Kassia, now the willing servant of the Melkur, is to become the new Keeper of Traken.
(4/4) Kassia completes the transition. The Melkur is only a shell, the real power lies within.
(1/4) To repair the TARDIS's chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth for a real police box.
(2/4) The Doctor travels to Logopolis where a series of fateful events are set in motion.
(3/4) The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet's secret.
(4/4) With the fate of the universe at stake, the Doctor and the Master must collaborate.
(1/4) The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans.
(2/4) A Grecian philosopher reveals a bizarre secret about Monarch.
(3/4) Tegan accidentally pilots the TARDS into space, while Lin Fitu betrays the Doctor.
(4/4) The Doctor undertakes a dangerous spacewalk to rescue Tegan.
(1/4) 17th century England is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure.
(2/4) The Terileptil leader is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats.
(3/4) A mesmerized Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.
(4/4) Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding.
(1/4) On Deva Loka, Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda.
(2/4) When Hindle's breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.
(3/4) Panna shows the Doctor what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.
(4/4) The Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension.
(1/4) The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room.
(2/4) The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctors regeneration is unstable.
(3/4) Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help.
(4/4) A recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva.
(1/2) As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive.
(2/2) The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthurs spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern.
(1/4) Silent but deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.
(2/4) With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.
(3/4) The Cybermen are released from their silos and on the march.
(4/4) The Doctor realizes the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard.
Concorde disappears back through a crack in time, so the Doctor follows its trail.

From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa.
The Master's TARDIS repaired, the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow.
The Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam...
Commander Maxil doesn't believe the Doctor is innocent.
Within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realizes the threat is far from over...
Omega has been reborn but as a walking anti-matter bomb.

(4/4) The Doctors ethics are challenged and the two Brigadier's finally meet.

A man is sent to a small town to assess which of the workers in the local factory that supplies the town with jobs should get the boot when the downsizing begins. He gets sidetracked when he falls in love with a local, single mom.

Veterinarian and part-time mayor Sarah heads a town council desperate to find a doctor to keep open the town's clinic. Their hopes are raised when a surgeon plans to visit for the first time in years for the Christmas holiday. The mayor's attempt to recruit the surgeon is complicated by their history (their high school romance) and his secret shame (that he has lost his confidence in his surgical skills in the big city hospital in which he works).

High-powered event planner Hayley Parker heads to the mountains for a quiet Christmas with her sister Amy, brother-in-law Tim, and his family—only to find Tim’s charming brother Paul is joining too. Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

Piper Jansen is a slick public relations genius and owner of her own company "Piper's Picks." After creating countless successful campaigns, she decides to use her grandmother's holiday recipes to write and launch a book of her own but, suddenly finds herself in the middle of a very public scandal that threatens the launch of the book as well as her business.

Two employees at a high-profile pet store become mismatched travel companions when they find themselves on the road together at Christmastime for a social media tour with the company mascot, a dog named Scoots.

A perfectionist holiday expert and a free-spirited bookstore owner find themselves in a spirited rivalry when a festive bet challenges them to prove whose approach to Christmas is truly the best. As they compete—her meticulous traditions against his carefree creativity—the town gets swept up in their holiday showdown. But amid twinkling lights, laughter, and unexpected sparks, they soon realize that love and compromise might be the real holiday magic.

Emily is determined to fulfil her father�s wishes to save the family dairy farm which has been financially struggling for years.  When a handsome stranger, Charlie, shows up at Emily�s family dairy farm at Christmastime, Emily has to hide her feelings for him when he turns out to be her sister�s partner and they are there to sell the farm. Can Emily get her Christmas miracle to save the family farm and win the handsome guy in the end?

With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

Maggie Colby runs away from her own wedding when she has doubts that she really loves her fiance, Douglas Wilshire. She tries to sort out her feelings while trapped by a blizzard in a lodge with her Grandmother and ex-boyfriend Colt. Will she get back with Colt or return to Douglas?

Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

Julia Rogers, an uptight, hardworking realty owner who’s lost her Christmas spirit, must spend five days at a festive Christmas Inn with her business rival, Chad Everest, to secure the coveted Erickson Farmstead listing. As their competition heats up, unexpected sparks fly, and Julia and Chad discover they share more in common than rivalry, finding that friendship—and maybe even love—can bloom amid holiday cheer.

A talented pastry chef returns to her hometown in Door County, WI, for the holidays, only to find herself torn between pursuing her dream job in the city or preserving her family’s cherished cherry orchard. With the orchard’s future uncertain, a lost cherry pie recipe, and the unexpected reappearance of her high school sweetheart, she must rediscover what truly matters—and decide if love and tradition can guide her future.

When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

High-powered event planner Hayley Parker heads to the mountains for a quiet Christmas with her sister Amy, brother-in-law Tim, and his family—only to find Tim’s charming brother Paul is joining too. Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

A man is sent to a small town to assess which of the workers in the local factory that supplies the town with jobs should get the boot when the downsizing begins. He gets sidetracked when he falls in love with a local, single mom.

Dateless for the Christmas ball, bachelor King Charles of Baltania tracks down Allison, his American college sweetheart, only to discover she has never been married, yet raised a 17-year-old daughter, Lily, who mathematically might be Charles' child.

When a talented assistant meets a handsome young prince in disguise, he is instantly smitten with her, mistaking her as the boss. As their relationship grows and the truth is revealed, she wonders if he would have still fallen for her if he knew she was an assistant, and not the boss.

Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

Lauren, a hard-working advertising executive, begins to fall for Paul, a consultant she has been paired with to land a big account for the upcoming holiday season. Unbeknownst to Lauren and everyone else, Paul is actually Prince Edward Charles, European royalty in disguise as a commoner.

Sydney, a go-getting federal agent, finds out that her down-on-his luck confidential informant in a criminal investigation suddenly goes missing, she begins a desperate scramble to continue her investigation. However, her luck hasn’t run out yet when she finds a man who is her informant's mirror image. She recruits this doppelgänger to play his role.

The holiday season is alive in New York, where a ballet rehearsal for The Nutcracker is underway. Carrie, the prima ballerina, focuses on guiding the young dancers around her. Meanwhile, Prince William is tasked with escorting Medea, a rising star ballerina, to New York. Medea's arrival disrupts the growing bond between Carrie and the Prince. When Medea is injured, the question arises: will Carrie step in to save the performance? Christmas magic may lead to more than just a show.

Prince Alexander of Fredonia, weary of his royal duties, escapes to America for Christmas, checking into a struggling inn under a false identity. Katie, the inn’s charming owner, welcomes Alex with open arms, unaware of his true status. As they share festive moments and grow closer, their bond deepens. But when Alex’s secret is revealed, Katie must decide if love is worth the risk of living in the royal spotlight.

programmes.t: A Christmas Castle Proposal: A Royal In Paradise 2
programmes.d: Olivia meets charming Alexander on the tropical Haven Isles, unaware he’s a prince. As they explore the island, friendship turns to romance—until a royal spy reveals his identity. Invited to spend Christmas at his majestic palace, Olivia faces royal traditions, strict protocol, and comedic culture clashes. Amid the chaos, love is tested, but a magical Christmas might bring the proposal of a lifetime.

Four years after the sweeping operation of Garibong-dong, Detective Ma Seok-do and his unit have an extradition mission - to transfer a surrendered suspect from Vietnam. When Ma and Team Leader Jeon meet him, he seems fearful of something. Ma and Jeon find out that he gets involved in a kidnap/murder case: the victim is a young businessman whose father is the giant loan shark in Seoul. The leader of the crime, Kang Hae-sang, is responsible for several other kidnap/murder cases targeting Koreans
In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues
An illegal immigrant from Mainland China sneaks into the corrupt British-colonized Hong Kong in 1963, transforming himself into a ruthless drug lord.
Rebels plan a hit on a Commander. To execute it, they break a jailed killer, evade a hitman, and uncover a traitor.

On a quest to find his missing brother, Taka teams up with a quirky new friend and an edgy, mysterious girl to take on a pack of vicious assassins with 9 lives!

The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

Seven-year-old Sang Woo is left with his grandmother in a remote village while his mother looks for work. Born and raised in the city, Sang Woo quickly comes into conflict with his old-fashioned grandmother and his new rural surroundings. Disrespectful and selfish, Sang Woo lashes out in anger, perceiving that he has been abandoned. He trades his grandmother's only treasure for a video game; he throws his food and he throws tantrums. When Sang Woo's mother finds work and finally returns for him,
An ex-con funeral director (Zhu Yilong) unexpectedly connects with a little girl (Yang Enyou) after the death of her grandmother, changing his outlook on life.

In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human sp
A young woman born into an all-female cult begins to question the teachings of her leader.
A young housewife in a seemingly perfect marriage develops pica, the irresistible urge to ingest inedible objects and material.

After his wife Lisa disappears on a business trip, Peter finds evidence that she has been having an affair with Ralph. He flies to Milan and enters into a complicated charade by befriending Ralph and slowly teasing information about Lisa out of him.

In the spring of 1840, a family gathers in their old, isolated farm house to mourn the loss of their matriarch. As the mourning proceeds, the circumstances of the matriarch's death come into question.
A married Hollywood agent receives a mysterious letter for an anonymous sexual encounter and becomes ensnared in a sinister world of lying, murder and infidelity.
Three ex-cons (Nicolas Cage, Willem Dafoe, Christopher Matthew Cook) find themselves on the run from the mob and the police after botching a plan to kidnap a baby for a large ransom.
An elderly couple turn the tables on a group of young thieves who broke into their house while they were away.
A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she is unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.
A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.
When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.
Before he is executed, Arthur Blake relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls to a priest.
Californian serial killer William Bonin (Scott Anthony Leet) searches for victims on the state's highways.
Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
When a widow ventures into a remote wilderness area with her son and best friend to spread her husband's ashes, a mysterious hiker begins dogging them and forces them to confront their deepest fears.
A New York detective investigates the death of his daughter, who was murdered while on her honeymoon in London, the victim of an apparent serial killer.
Locals in the California woods are attacked by supernatural creatures, and when the situation escalates into carnage, a farmer struggles to defend his family.
Venomous betrayals engulf a female married couple attempting to celebrate their one-year anniversary.
As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.
Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

Oga and Kunieda head off to Mapputatsu to train with Kunieda's grandpa, while Lamia recruits Furuichi to find Lord En himself. Furuichi ends up running into Kanzaki and the rest of the usual Ishiyama bunch, and decides to make this a problem for the whole school!

Oga is at Mapputatsu for training with Aoi's grandpa! And his first task is to split a stone with his bare hands?! Meanwhile, Furuichi and the gang continue their search for Lord En, but he doesn't seem to be anywhere... Will there be any progress made this episode at all?!

Furuichi and Lamia have a single lead to find Lord En: He's totally hooked on online games! So the whole Ishiyama gang heads over to Himekawa's private gaming rooms to find Lord En online and figure out where he is. Finding him isn't hard, but getting him to tell where he is will take besting him in a gaming showdown!
Political fixer Pomade Jaws trusts no one, not even his wife Laura. He's stored the scandalous secrets of various world leaders inside a voice-activated safe.

Lupin, Jigen and Goemon have turned themselves in to the FBI, but it's all part of the plan. Their real goal is to break out old man Clyde Barlow, who was once known as a genius bank robber, to get his help with their heist of the National Super Bank.

Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.
In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.
The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

programmes.t: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Subtitle]
programmes.d: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

Knuckles recalls how Chaos destroyed the Master Emerald. Suspecting that Chaos is controlling Froggy, the gang decide to head their own ways in search of rescuing Froggy and recovering the Chaos Emerald.
As Knuckles blames himself for not being able to guard the Master Emerald, Sonic and Tails take off in the X-Tornado to save Amy from the Egg Carrier.
Sonic, Tails and Knuckles battle Dr. Eggman on the Egg Carrier to save Amy and for the last piece of Master Emerald. Meanwhile, Chris and Big are still in search of Froggy.

As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.

After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

Now, the women have suffered another tragedy: coonhound Nyla has become explosively aggressive, accidentally killing one family dog and viciously attacking another. Cesar needs to help the entire Thompson pack heal from past wounds and rehabilitate Nyla before the family is faced with a heartbreaking decision.

Cesar Millan is challenged by three barking bichon frises that are threatening the owner's business, then he heads to meet with The Freedom Writers, where a teacher struggles to provide leadership to her students.
Cesar Millan must rehabilitate two aggressive boxers who have been terrorizing their neighborhood, and then he must help a pregnant dance teacher stop her chihuahua from attacking her dance students.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar aids a family of first responders with three large and out-of-control dogs, including an aggressive pit bull. With help from his own pack, Cesar teaches the family new techniques to prevent dangerous behavior and get this pack back on track. First-time dog owners of an over-excited Bernedoodle with separation anxiety look to Cesar for guidance to bring order to their home.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan’s Leader of the Pack
programmes.d: Brigadiere is a mixed-breed dog that has been in a shelter for six months. Timid, insecure and fearful of people, he needs a leader who has real patience and understanding.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's cantankerous Chihuahua, whose recent blindness makes him increasingly hostile to be around. And later, a family makes a desperate plea to Cesar to help them rein in their fast-growing and overexcited Belgian Malinois before he becomes too tough to tame.

The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.
The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.
Crichton, Aeryn and Crais are welcomed aboard Scorpius' carrier; Scorpius promises amnesty in exchange for wormhole technology; Scorpius threatens to destroy something close to Crichton's heart.
An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.
Danish Crichton tries to survive aboard the Elack; a female alien and mercenaries are keen to harvest Elack's neural tissue.
Crichton falls under the control of the mysterious and dangerous allure and control of Commandant Grayza.
D'Argo and Sikozu develop a plan to run into the Peacekeepers' ship with Elack, but success requires Crichton getting closer to Grayza.
The crew faces a lava-filled cave and a mercenary squad after an emergency landing.
The crew reunites at Moya, where Crichton discovers that Aeryn is suffering from heatstroke and is being cared for by Scorpius, who is seeking asylum at Moya.
Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange and twisted versions of their friends.
When a gang of bounty hunters overtakes Moya, Crichton must team with a dubious ally.
Chiana and Crichton are sucked into a game world ruled by a virtual stark; to escape, they must fight against friends and enemies in disguises.
An alien doctor poisons the Moya's crew with deadly mollusks.
An interdimensional being believes that Crichton's wormhole knowledge threatens the universe.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985, and he has altered the timeline, causing his father to be scheduled to fly on the doomed shuttle Challenger.
The aliens meet an amazed and apprehensive public; Crichton tries to readjust to life on Earth.
Chiana purchases an abused slave girl from a passing trading ship.
Scorpius takes Crichton, D'Argo and Rygel to an advanced training camp where students learn mental discipline.
The women of Moya stumble upon a secret meeting that will change the future of the Uncharted Territories.

programmes.t: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programmes.d: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.
Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.
Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.
In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.
