Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programmes.t: From The Scene For The Scene
programmes.d: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
The hot tub time machine is fired up again for more side-splitting adventures, this time in the future!
A woman embarks on a journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before the world ends.
A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.
Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!
Martin Short stars as a ten-year-old who plans revenge on his uncle (Charles Grodin).
Weird Al Yankovic plays a daydreamer who becomes the manager of a TV station that's losing ratings and money.
Our righteous heroes Bill and Ted discover their destiny in a time-travelling phone booth! Excellent!
The titular time travelers become history when they wind up face to face with the Grim Reaper!
In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!
A powerful portrait of disaffected teens based on the horrifying real-life murder of a young California girl.
Passion and power struggles unfold when a young woman will do anything to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl!
Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.
Robin Williams headlines this joy ride of comic lunacy about a car salesman who must face a jealous husband.

Greetings, Earthlings. A pint-sized extraterrestrial has just landed on Earth by accident...and he's feeling a little, well, alienated because he got separated from his family. But MAC will transform the lives of everyone he meets...forever!
A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.
Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!
To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.
Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!
A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.
A gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles.
Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.
The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.
When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programmes.t: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programmes.d: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.
Scream legends Vincent Price, Peter Lorre and Boris Karloff are three rival sorcerers whose paths cross when one is turned into a raven by another!
A century after a warlock was burned alive, his descendant (Vincent Price) inherits the family estate and the horrors of the past return to haunt him.

programmes.t: The Masque Of The Red Death (1964)
programmes.d: Death and debauchery reign in the castle of Price Prospero (Vincent Price)...and when it reigns it pours...in this lavish Edgar Allan Poe adaptation.
Vincent Price's deceased first wife, Ligeia, casts a long shadow over his ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns.
When a soldier encounters a haunting woman on a desolate beach, his hunt for her leads to a dark, foreboding castle and its mysterious owner.

Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!
On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!
When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

programmes.t: The Return Of The Living Dead
programmes.d: On his first day at a medical supply warehouse, Freddy (Thom Mathews) unwittingly releases toxic gas from a secret U.S. military canister. The gas reanimates an army of corpses, who arise from their graves with a ravenous hunger...for human brains!

In this atmospheric horror classic directed by special effect legend Stan Winston, Ed Harley (Lance Henriksen) seeks the help of a witch to invoke the demon "Pumpkinhead" in order to exact revenge on the teenagers who inadvertently killed his son.
A maniacal murderer (Brion James) returns from the depths of hell to seek revenge on the cop who captured him in this supernatural horror-fest!

The Calvin Finishing School for Girls is closed for Christmas vacation.  However, Mrs. Jensen (the housemother), five teenage girls and their mischievous male companions are all that remain at the school...or are they?
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!
Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!
Virtuoso of horror Vincent Price ("Tales of Terror") dials up the depravity in this spellbinding trilogy of Nathaniel Hawthorne's chilling classics!
The legendary Vincent Price turns in another classic performance in this intelligent and grim thriller about a magistrate who just might be possessed.
Vincent Price buries his disfigured brother alive, but the body is dug up by a doctor (Christopher Lee). Still alive, the brother seeks his revenge.
A scientist commits a series of murders in his quest to create a race of super humans. Vincent Price, Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing star.
When a washed-up horror actor (Vincent Price) agrees to do a TV-series, the cast begin dying in ways similar to the deaths in the actor's old movies.

The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!
Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programmes.d: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

In our very first solo episode of Rooted in Wellness, we explore the transformative power of being anchored like a sturdy tree—steady, grounded, and unwavering amidst life's storms. We'll illuminate how feeling rooted manifests as inner peace, emotional stability, and a profound connection with yourself and the world around you.

Have you ever felt like your hormones are playing a tune out of sync with your well-being? Chances are, they probably are. The good news? There's a transformative journey waiting for women when they realign with nature, pay attention to their meals, and practice intermittent fasting the right way.

Did you know that your metabolic health and energy are controlled by our modern food? This means your metabolism is not broken! You just need to work on healing your metabolism through simple lifestyle shifts you can easily apply to your life today.How? This is what we dive into in this episode of Rooted in Wellness with Casey Means.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

Miniature dinosaurs help a boy outwit a malevolent governess who wants to pack him off to a military boarding school.
A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.
An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.
After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.
An asylum escapee (Larry Drake) plays doctor on a killing spree, then decides to do a heart transplant.
An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).
A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.
A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.

En el Valle del Cauca, Luis Emiro Acosta Pérez estafó a cientos de personas prometiendo viviendas. En Bogotá, César Augusto Pinzón cobró por impugnar comparendos y desapareció. Tramitadores de visas engañaron a personas prometiendo citas rápidas en la embajada americana. Las víctimas buscan justicia.
El uso de aplicaciones de citas va en aumento, y mientras unos encuentran el amor, otros caen en la violencia.

Usuarios de buses intermunicipales que sufrieron accidentes de tránsito denuncian que las empresas no les respondieron. Casos en Tolima, Cundinamarca y Bolívar muestran negligencia y falta de responsabilidad. Las víctimas buscan justicia y compensación por los daños sufridos.

Luisa Fernanda Garcés, de 13 años, desapareció en Villamaría, Caldas, en agosto de 2014, un día después de que su familia denunciara un abuso sexual sufrido meses antes. Su cuerpo fue hallado en el río Cauca. Gabriel Jaime Marulanda, el agresor identificado, fue capturado en 2015 y condenado a 46 años por homicidio agravado y 9 años más por actos sexuales con menor de edad.

En 2009, desaparece Lía Patricia Nasser, estudiante de derecho de 26 años en Barranquilla. Entre los sospechosos: un compañero de colegio, su novio y la exnovia de su esposo. Tras descartar la hipótesis inicial, la investigación llevó a la captura de Eduardo Osa, compañero universitario, cuya culpabilidad quedó demostrada. La necropsia reveló asfixia mecánica. Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

María Inés, de 21 años, soñaba con ser ingeniera de minas. Empezó una relación con Yobany, casado y mayor. En 2011, embarazada de 4 meses, fue hallada asesinada en su casa. La policía sospecha de un crimen pasional y revisa cámaras para hallar pistas

Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

El Rastro cumple 10 años revelando crímenes reales, mentes criminales e impactantes investigaciones. A través de 117 episodios, el programa ha marcado la TV colombiana con historias estremecedoras y casos que retan la imaginación.

En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Aunque su esposo fue el primer sospechoso, la investigación reveló que el verdadero culpable era su sobrino, quien la asesinó para robar los ahorros de su tío. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

Daneidy Barrera, "Epa Colombia," relata cómo en 2019 atacó estaciones de Transmilenio durante los paros, arrepintiéndose y entregándose a las autoridades. Desde niña ayudaba a sus padres vendiendo ropa, y tras superar una adicción a las drogas, se volvió viral apoyando a la Selección Colombia. Hoy es empresaria exitosa con más de 500 empleados en su negocio de keratinas, aunque su fama la mantiene bajo escrutinio judicial.
En Bocas de Satinga, hombres armados talan árboles finos en 3 días. La madera se transporta ilegalmente por río, un comercio tan rentable como el narcotráfico y difícil de controlar.

Colombia registró la víctima 12.000 de minas antipersonal, ubicándose como el segundo país más afectado tras Afganistán. En los Montes de María, 172 hombres del Batallón Humanitario de Desminado de la Infantería de Marina arriesgan sus vidas escarbando la tierra centímetro a centímetro para desactivar minas. El teniente Juan Carlos narra esta peligrosa labor diaria contra un enemigo invisible.

Amanda le contó a su mejor amiga Dorella que se acostó con su prometido Joey. ¡Ahora Amanda afirma que Joey podría ser el padre de su hijo! Luego, Tommy dice que no es el padre del bebé de Kim y ¿es Deshawn el padre del bebé de Tifanny?
Kiki y su hermana Sad-e aseguran que el novio de Kiki, Tavon, es un infiel. ¿Qué dirán cuando aparezca en nuestra cámara oculta? Entonces, ¿los hijos de James y Nikkie son realmente suyos?

Los invitados del episodio de hoy de MAURY tienen secretos que revelar, pero ¿se arrepentirán de contarlos? Hay relaciones en peligro. Puede que haya corazones rotos. ¿Podrán estas parejas sobrevivir a los secretos que amenazan con separarlos? Entérate en el episodio de MAURY de hoy.
¿Marlo tocó a su hija con Sandra cuando ella tenía 7 años? Ha evitado confrontarla durante casi 10 años, pero hoy, Sandra no se irá hasta que no se sepa la verdad y se haga justicia por su hija.

Una madre casada con seis hijos dice que ha terminado con su marido y que está enamorada de un chico de 17 años; Shyaina dice que el novio de su mejor amiga le hizo insinuaciones sexuales y la manoseó a espaldas de su amiga.
Un hombre transgénero tiene dudas sobre casarse con una mujer; Germaine quiere que su ex lo acepte de nuevo y revela un secreto; el marido de Stormie le da un ultimátum.
El novio de Priscilla la engaña y la culpa a ella y a su embarazo; Santana promete cambiar, pero quizá sea tarde; Scoota busca beneficios de pareja sin compromiso.
En este episodio especial, un grupo de espectadores selectos se enfrentará a algunos de los más memorables invitados de Jerry.
Tori confiesa que ha estado durmiendo con el novio de su madre; Tabitha quiere que su hombre admita su mala conducta; Daniel defiende su caso a través de una canción.
Shianne confiesa que fue infiel a Mistress Delicious con su mamá Blonde. Después, la madre del bebé de Chris se enfrenta a él por dejarla por su compañera de trío.
Nikki revela sus aventuras fraternales secretas, pero ¿podrá Joe perdonarla? Después, "Six O'Clock" confiesa que ha estado acostándose con el novio de su amiga Carisa por dinero.

En Cali, vecinos del barrio La Independencia tomaron justicia por mano propia tras el robo a Sara Ortega. Cansados de la impunidad, golpearon al ladrón, Jaime Barona López, con antecedentes desde 2002. La comunidad, frustrada por la inseguridad, busca soluciones ante la falta de acción judicial.

Carlos Ariel Torres, líder de una secta, estafó a sus seguidores con promesas de salvación apocalíptica y manipulación, llevándolos a vender bienes para comprar tierras en Ecuador. Actualmente, enfrenta varias denuncias por fraude.

La tragedia de los incendios en Colombia expone la precariedad de los cuerpos de Bomberos: escasez de personal, equipos deficientes y falta de recursos impiden atender emergencias, dejando comunidades desprotegidas y vidas en riesgo.

Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.
Los venezolanos que cometen delitos en Colombia generan un polémico debate sobre qué hacer.

Ana, víctima de abuso por su profesor, ve justicia tras años de denuncias. Judith, asesinada en Bogotá, revela una red criminal. Valentina, presunto suicidio, resulta ser homicidio. Angelie, con Diamond Blackfan, recibe un trasplante exitoso. Harvey, policía herido, lucha por su recuperación y justicia.

El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

En la Guajira, Maye rescata niños víctimas de explotación sexual. Carlos Iván vive con el Síndrome de Prader-Willi, mientras que un grupo de jóvenes colombianos construyen con llantas en China, mostrando talento y sostenibilidad.

Elaine Palacio, la única modelo colombiana en portadas de Vogue Italia y ángel de Victoria's Secret, nació en Puerto Boyacá enfrentando racismo y baja autoestima. A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.

¿Por qué Q, de 21 años, y Alicia, de 55, no tienen sexo más a menudo? Entonces, Jenny se enamoró de un hombre 10 años menor que ella y ha estado encontrando fotos de mujeres desnudas en su teléfono, pero ¿le ha estado engañando?

¿Antonio ha sido infiel a Chasity desde el día de su boda? ¿Mike se está acostando con Lisa, la madre de su esposa? Jackie asegura que Danny es infiel y él asegura que ella lo es... ¡Maury tiene todos los resultados!
Lanikka está harta de los abusos de su novio Malcom. Después, los celos de Tim han destrozado su familia, pero ahora está desesperado por recuperarlos, ¿Tiffany lo dejará definitivamente?
Pamela quiere pesar 40 libras. Samantha, que sufre de bulimia y alcoholismo, roba para consumir sus atracones. ¿Pueden las dos mujeres lidiar con sus desórdenes alimenticios con apoyo y tratamiento?

After barely surviving prison, the demented Firefly clan go on the run, unleashing a whole new wave of mayhem.

A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.
Rustlers take Fury, but when Peter and Joey try to rescue the stallion, he winds up rescuing them.
Jim is adamant about not selling Fury, until Joey suffers an injury that requires an expensive surgery immediately.
Buzz is unimpressed when Joey joins the Boy Scouts.
Joey convinces Pete to lead a camping trip, which causes a panic when the doctor learns the dog that bit Joey before leaving was rabid.
A rodeo champion gets himself injured and Jim invites him to the ranch.
The father of a new boy at school expects him to spend all his free time studying.
The mortgage holder convinces Joey to enter Fury in a winner-take-all horse race.
Everybody joins in the search for a little girl who has wandered off.
John Strongheart is being questioned in connection to the murder of Duncan Kilmore; Chance and Roy try to get some answers out of a guy named Sanchez.
When Roy gets ambushed, he sets out on his own; Colleen finds out just how close Chance and her dead ex-husband were.
Rancher Jim Newton saves a horse, and later saves a young orphan, and the horse and boy develop a bond.
A wild stallion is menacing all the local ranches and frees the horses.
Jim must sell some horses or lose the ranch, but he refuses to sell Fury, leading Piggott to trick him onto free government land with the horse, allowing Piggott to claim the stallion.
Joey and Pete go hunting, but what they find is trouble when an escaped criminal crosses their path.
During a drought, Joey becomes a junior ranger and tries to protect a couple of hunters from starting a forest fire.
Fury keeps running off to be with a white mare; Joey gets in trouble when he tries to solve the relationship.
A blacksmith's daughter helps two lawmen round up a group of cattle rustlers.
A gang hijacks shipments of gold from Goldville. Ace Benton, the town's leading citizen is trying to acquire all the town property, as he knows the railroad is planning a line through there.
Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekicks (George Hayes, Russell Hayden) stop rustlers and help a schoolmarm tame singing boys.
Their friend has been murdered, so cowboys "Lightning" Bill Carson (Tim McCoy) and Magpie McGillicuddy (Ben Corbett) are out for justice, leading Bill to don a mask and pose as "the Phantom."
A frontier lawman partners with an American Indian detective to hunt down a ruthless band of teenage criminals known as the Rufus Buck Gang.
A retired Union contract scout embarks on a deadly mission to find out what happened to his true love and her little girl.

Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.
A corrupt Indian agent frames a Cherokee chief for horse theft.
Bandits seek a map revealing hidden treasure in a mission.
Range Rider (Jock Mahoney) tracks two kidnappers whose plans he and Dick (Dick Jones) interrupted. With Lonnie Burr, Pamela Blake.
An outlaw poses as the sheriff he murdered.
A killer's reign of terror keeps townspeople in their homes.
Range Rider (Jock Mahoney) and Dick (Dick Jones) capture a gang with the help of a U.S. marshal (Stanley Andrews) who was being held hostage.
Range Rider and Dick help when a respected rancher collapses in the street and the town doctor is held captive by outlaws.
Range Rider (Jock Mahoney) and Dick (Dick Jones) assist Jean Snyder (Pamela Blake) in building a telegraph line.

Sheriff Lawson wires for a Federal Land Commissioner to check on the various titles to land in the Mesquite district; One-Eye, under orders from Drake, attempts to halt the stagecoach and kill Treadway, the land agent.
Mesquite banker Calvin Drake plans to profit from Santa Fe Railroad by gaining control of all the land in the territory.
Red carries Beth to shore after the stagecoach hits the water; Red and Beth capture Shark and bring him to the Mesquite jail.
Cherokee saves Red from certain death; Drake convinces the ranchers that the raids are over.
Red derails a mining car before it can crush him; the henchmen escape with the rancher's money.
Red escapes from the water tank hazard and orders the cowhands to start moving the cattle to the Lazy-W Ranch; Hanlon learns of this plan and prepares to stop them.
Red, carrying Beth, reaches the safety of an overhanging ledge; Red moves the herd to the BAR-M Ranch; to raise money, Red organizes a Wells-Fargo stagecoach race.
Dale unknowingly buys a stove containing stolen payroll money from a local peddler (Dub Taylor).
An attractive milliner and her grandfather are suspects in a plot to rob the Wells Fargo office.
Pat and his cousin inherit some land that is coveted by some unscrupulous ranchers.
Roy saves a group of archeological students taken hostage by robbers.
An outlaw gang tries to steal an old prospector's life savings.
An outlaw gang assigns an orphaned teenager (Harry Harvey, Jr.) the task of murdering Roy.
Roy debunks an old Western legend about a one-armed ghost.
A government agent is killed after he orders a stop to beaver trapping in the region.
A 10-year-old orphan (B.G. Norman) protects his uncle's illegal gold mine.
A lady banker turns to murder in order to gain possession of some oil-rich property.

This episode, a new Robot Wars champion will emerge! Sparks and scraps are sure to fly in this explosive series finale. Winners will have to make it through the four-way melees and head-to-head battles to be able to prove themselves in the final.

Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.
A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?
Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.

One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.

The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.
After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

Robot fightings newest competition begins! In the first heat, meet new robots and some familiar faces as teams get a feel for the arena and size up their competition. Filmed in Grantham in front of a live audience, robots battle for survival in the Robots Live Arena.

Heat 2 of the UKs most brutal robot combat competition takes the action to Crawley in the south of England. Winners and losers from Heat 1 face fresh opponents, fighting to secure a win and guarantee their place in the finals.

Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.
The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.
The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?

Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.
Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.

Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.
When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."
Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.
Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.

Mike and Ming participate in a 5K zombie run for Kevin's charity; Walt buys an unusual item.

programmes.t: Christmas With A Prince: Becoming Royal
programmes.d: Its Christmas again and Dr Tasha is on her way to meet Prince Alexander in St. Savarre. Though this is a happy time it is also a very stressful as a treaty is being negotiated between St. Savarre and Vandelien. When Tasha arrives, Alex surprises her by asking for her hand in marriage. She accepts and they immediately begin planning the wedding. When Princess Miranda finds out she is not happy and concocts a plan to put a halt to this fairy-tale.

Ambitious New York events planner Kelly is one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's birthday, Kelly soon realizes that she may have met her match.

Robinson Tech is launching a new dating service that they ensure will find your Perfect Match. But when its's CEO and tech developer are challenged on Live TV to test the service themselves, the algorithm shows some interesting results.

Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.
A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

Pediatric specialist Tasha Miller is caring for two young patients plus one sinfully gorgeous royal. She knew Prince Alexander at boarding school long ago and thinks he's still a self-absorbed, incorrigible heartbreaker. But when Tasha sees him with the children, his kindness and caring nature shine through so brightly that Dr. Tasha can't help but be attracted.

They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there’s something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade’s competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole’s business.

As they work together to find animals homes during the Christmas adoption season, they develop feelings for each other, and help each other with the challenges each faces.

Mark, hoping to impress his boss, talks Isla up and gets her to do the job, but there's one problem...Isla's never sculpted before. With Mark's encouragement, Isla's confidence blossoms and so does their love.

Matt and Bruno are working on a 2006 Dodge Ram with a ton of problems…but why just make the repairs? Go better than stock!
Matt visits the Wheels for Hope Garage in Raleigh, NC and sees first hand how this organization is changing lives.
Matt and Bruno upgrade the Dana 35 rear end in a 2000 Jeep TJ to a much stronger Ford 8.8 one and do it for under $500.
Every light on your dashboard means something. Matt and Bruno diagnose and repair a vehicle that came to the shop to them with warning lights.
Nobody likes to fix a truck on the side of the road. That’s why there’s roadside assistance. Matt and Bruno take a stock F250 and turn it into a purpose-built Road Ranger.
With two days and a ton of truck parts anything can happen. Matt and Bruno put together build teams to see who can complete the toughest rig.
The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.

Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free ’55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It’s nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can sup

Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis!  Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.
In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Scerif

Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.
A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.
Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.
Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.
A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.
Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!
Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

When the guys get their hands on a clean 1986 square-body C-10, they give it a facelift…and a suspension drop.  With its brand-new look and stance, Willie and Kevin can’t wait to reveal the truck to its owner.

Kevin and Willie have an Autobahn edition 2013 MK6 VW GTI in the shop for performance upgrades.  With a new turbo kit, exhaust, and a few other improvements, the guys plan to boost this car’s status from “daily driver” to “head-turner.”

A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads.  Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?

If you’re headed for the formidable Moab Desert, your Jeep had better be ready for anything.  Willie and Kevin are outfitting a Wrangler TJ and a Cherokee XJ to handle the harsh environment of the desert.
Kevin hits the road to Bolingbrook, Illinois to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America”, as he tours WeatherTech to see how they make all those great American products.

The guys have a Mini Cooper S in the shop today.  They add some horsepower, some stopping power, and fix up a worn-out suspension to improve handling. Then they see if they can even fit in it for the test drive!
Kevin and Willie have a problematic Trailblazer in the shop today. They tackle multiple issues and get it up and runnin’ again.  The guys also kick start a performance build project on a Gen5 Camaro!
The guys have a 6 Speed 2015 Mustang GT in the shop and they’re adding some power by installing a cold air intake, an exhaust package, a tune, and a … thermostat?
The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.
The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.
What UTV should you buy? Should it be a Can Am Commander or a Razor RZR? Matt and Bruno show you what kind of upgrades you can do to each of them, and then they have some fun on the trails!

Matt and Bruno show you what a car dealership is going to look for when your truck hits a 100-thousand miles to determine its trade in value. Matt and Bruno show you what kind of repairs you can do yourself to get the most value on your truck.
The gloves are off….so is the exhaust, DPF, and anything else that makes our diesel track truck street legal. Today a King Ranch is getting ready for a date with the drag strip.
A final wish list from a customer gets completed on a 1985 C-10 project truck, and we cure a slipping transmission problem on a Dodge.
When your work truck gets wrecked, your ability to work stops. Matt and Bruno take on a project to get a work truck back on the road with some body work and repair.

Matt and Bruno ‘s Jeep project is going to be a beast when they get finished with it. The guys install a supercharger and a long arm suspension to give it some life, and they finish it up with a new exhaust and a mean front bumper that will provide the “bite.”  Then, the beast is unleashed!
Kevin and Willie are working on a build again, but this time it’s no work truck! They’re diving in head first on a 550 Horsepower Cobra Replica Kit Car!
Kevin and Willie have a Gen 1 Camaro in the shop and their work is cut out for them! They’re installing a new sub frame, rack and pinion, brakes, gauges … and that’s just half of the work!

The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.
The Strongman Champions League kicks off its 2014 season in Martinique.
The second stage of 2014 Strongman champions League, in Cologne, Germany. 14 athletes from 12 different countries battled through six events on the second stop
The third episode is hosted in Serbia where world records are broken!
The fourth episode takes place in Finland with events such as Bus Pull and the forward hold
The next stage of the SCL takes place in Holland with events such as the Atlas Stones and Truck Pull being witnessed
The SCL is in full swing and the sixth stage takes place in Latvia where the men are eager to break a national record held here
The competition continues in Portugal with 6 events and thousands of spectators
Episode 8 takes place in 36 degree heat in Croatia and sees the return of Krzysztof Radzikowski after a 2 month absence due to injury
SCL returns to Poland with 12 athletes all battling for the number one title
The 10th stage takes place in Hungary and features new super talent!
The first ever SCL in Zambia! The athletes get to take in some of the stunning sights and go on to do events such as Tyre Flip and Log Lift
The competition moves to Romania and for the first time this season the athletes compete in rainy conditions which make the events even tougher
The next stage of the competition takes place in Lithunia and world records are once again broken!
Episode 14 takes place in Estonia where drama and world records will be seen again
Taking place over 2 days in Malaysia, this is part 1 of the world finals of Strongman Champions League!
Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.
Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.
The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.
Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.
We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.
The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.
This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.
The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.
This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.
A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.
After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital during a powerful storm, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora's (Adelaide Kane) life.

With the threat growing more personal and time running out, Scott (Tyler Posey) is forced to make a difficult choice to save family and friends while, at the same time, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) try to figure out how to save Cora.

In the mid-season finale, under Deaton's advice, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends use an ancient but dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion (Gideon Emery) from achieving his sinister goal.

Weeks after saving the lives of their parents, Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer strange side effects from their ritual sacrifice. At the same time, the newly enlightened Sheriff Stilinski scours through old cases, looking for supernatural causes.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends race to figure out how to catch the Werecoyote Malia before it's hunted down and killed by her father. Meanwhile, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) are broken out of captivity by an unlikely ally.

On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

With Beacon Hills under curfew due to the power outage, the teens decide to throw a black light Halloween party while Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to get Kira (Arden Cho) to trust him in the midst of an attack by a strange new threat.

Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy, while Argent, Isaac and Allison search the past for answers to the shadow creatures. At the same time, Stiles, fearing he is going insane, reaches out to Melissa for help.

After suffering from hallucinations for some time, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously disappears one night and it's up to Scott (Tyler Posey) and the gang to figure out whether he has been kidnapped…and if the Oni had anything to do with it.

Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously reappears, but is he himself? Meanwhile, Scott (Tyler Posey) must prevent a disaster and Lydia (Holland Roden) and Allison (Crystal Reed) seek help from an unlikely source...Peter Hale (Ian Bohen).

Stiles checks himself into a mental hospital named Echo House where he believes he will be safe from the Nogitsune. Will he be as far away from it as he thinks or closer than ever? Meanwhile Scott, Allison and Lydia look for a cure for him.

While Allison, Derek, Chris and Sheriff Stilinski try to track down Nogitsune, Kira's mother tells the story of the Nogitsune she came to know. Meanwhile, the Nogitsune has taken complete control of Stiles and manages to stay one step ahead.

With the Nogitsune still in control of their friend Stiles, Scott and Lydia find an unlikely ally in Peter Hale. Elsewhere, the effects of the Nogitsune have given Chris, Alison and Kira some trouble with four out-of-control werewolves.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and company race to rescue Lydia (Holland Roden) from the clutches of evil and get help from a young woman who has escaped from the metal hospital. But the Nogitsune makes a surprise move, resulting in a tragic loss to the group.

In the Season 4 finale, struck by disaster and nearly defeated, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) call on their friends and allies to make one last stand against the Nogitsune. And someone thought dead makes a surprising return.
Scott and his Pack journey into Mexico to rescue a missing friend.
Scott must turn to an unlikely ally in order to stop Kate's plan.
A new Freshman player threatens Scott's position on the Lacrosse team. Stilinski investigates a brutal murder.
Uninvited guests arrive at Lydia's lake house on the night of the full moon. Derek tracks down a killer.

As another name is scratched off the list, Lydia is required to find the second key, thus revealing more targets. Scott, Stiles and Kira are on high alert after realizing that the assassin is on the lacrosse team.
With Violet's arrest, Garrett forces Scott to help get her back by using Liam as a bargaining chip. Stiles, Lydia and Jordan seek Meredith's help to uncover the third key.

A frantic call to the CDC has everyone paranoid, especially since it was designed to target werewolves. Scott, Malia and Kira lock themselves in the Hale vault, unaware of their salvation within their grasp.

With Noshiko's help, the team come up with a plan hoping to reveal the benefactor's identity. But Kate's arrival threatens to ruin it all. Malia comes face-to-face with Peter in the Hale vault, thus delving into her past.

After a vain attempt to kill Parrish, it's clear that almost everyone has access to the dead-pool. Lydia dives into her grandmother's past, uncovering yet another list which leads her to Eichen House. The team soon realizes no one is safe.
Scott and Kira fight to protect Satomi's pack from assassins. Stiles and Malia learn the origins of The Dead Pool.
Scott and his Pack begin a dangerous battle against an old enemy.
Scott and Stiles return to La Iglesia in order to save the pack from Kate.
